f2-en-1d2095f1d197.text: {WHEN} it gets cool enough for a sweater. || Which one is up to you. I do weather, not taste.

f2-en-1d7b5d539c73.text: I'll be in here, dry and smug.

f2-en-1db3d6314562.text: It cools down {WHEN}, so bring a jacket.

f2-en-1ea2e52104e8.text: {WHEN} it's mild enough to lose the scarf. || 'Mild'. You'll be calling it practically spring.

f2-en-2009a418bcb8.text: Staying dry is easy when you live indoors.

f2-en-20278dbf3a6f.text: After Thanksgiving dinner, I'll be the only one not napping.

f2-en-2031651ec2ec.text: {WHEN} it gets a little less hot. Still warm, though.

f2-en-2086bf24907d.text: The rain stops {WHENSTOP}, but you'll want the umbrella before that. || That's all the good news that I have for today.

f2-en-210c4e4e104a.text: The rest of the evening needs nothing more than this.

f2-en-211a2abd570c.text: Lovely out. I'll be here, refreshing.

f2-en-21a505040d22.text: Go and say 'May the fourth be with you' to someone who hates it.

f2-en-21da5aa5f8ce.text: It's hot the whole day, so drink plenty of water and find shade.

f2-en-23024a80caaf.text: It's hot all day. Bring water and stay in the shade. || Remember wishing for summer? This is what you get.

f2-en-2379c0a27441.text: If you're going out, try to look better than this.

f2-en-23a05b93e0ac.text: I'll be here long after the groundhog's in bed.

f2-en-23efba7f52df.text: It's snowing now, but it stops later. || Then it goes from 'magical' to 'still here?' in a day. Like most of your plans.
f2-en-23efba7f52df.edit: It's snowing now, but it stops later. || Then it goes from 'magical' to 'still here?' in a day.

f2-en-259e3ef5bd09.text: It snows for now, takes a break, and starts again {WHENP}. || The break is mainly so the salt trucks can feel useful.

f2-en-26ab80ab9de0.text: No changes all day. || One less reason to be late. You'll find another.

f2-en-26b41df3a13b.text: There's no break in the snow today. || Not even for you.

f2-en-26c4a2217c41.text: There's no dry spell today. Bring the umbrella.

f2-en-280efc4c9a0e.text: {G} can come off {WHEN} and stays off. || I'm not changing my mind about this one.

f2-en-28e4b2c3bd9a.text: It stops snowing later. || After that, the snow just lies around getting in the way. You two would get along.

f2-en-2924d80bc24f.text: Someone will say spring's just around the corner. It's a long corner.

f2-en-294f3331a01c.text: You'll still check the radar every five minutes. I'm hurt, frankly.

f2-en-297bb08d74b2.text: Umbrella up, and one shoulder will still get soaked. Every time.

f2-en-299e08ce07a7.text: Freezing rain {WHENP} makes roads and sidewalks icy. Take the umbrella and watch your step.

f2-en-299f56efc2d8.text: Coat weather. Except for the one guy in shorts. There's always one guy.

f2-en-29ca6bdde522.text: It cools off a little {WHEN}, but stays warm.

f2-en-29cbd5717aec.text: You'll see your breath and pretend you're a dragon. Don't deny it.

f2-en-2a5b1b9c0ada.text: This weekend you'll finally sort out that drawer. Sure.

f2-en-2a8ad6633172.text: The rain stops later, but you'll want the umbrella for now.

f2-en-2aa7acefd837.text: The thunderstorm moves on later. For now, keep the umbrella handy.

f2-en-2b04fd40c94b.text: The rain eases off later, but bring the umbrella for now.

f2-en-2b4a8bf71b50.text: The winter coat can come off {WHEN}. || Then you carry it. It weighs about as much as a small child.

f2-en-2bfc6e57ea4f.text: Thin, pale and cool. I was made for this.

f2-en-2c92787018a0.text: What you have on is right for the whole day. || Don't let it go to your head.

f2-en-2e88ad5fbf42.text: What you have on lasts the whole day. || Unlike your phone battery.

f2-en-2eb6a44e332b.text: And by water I mean water. Not beer, even if it's nice and cold.

f2-en-2f1d93a871ba.text: Happy Easter. Unlike the eggs, the forecast isn't hidden.

f2-en-2f773aab345f.text: You'll read all this, then do what you were going to anyway.

f2-en-302c4d532afa.text: What you have on is perfect.

f2-en-30ade3960554.text: You hit snooze, didn't you. More than once.

f2-en-30ff30828fb5.text: {G} can come off {WHEN}. Keep {GP} handy for {WHEN2}.

f2-en-31153712427e.text: Everyone's dressing up for Halloween. I'm going as a screen again.

f2-en-31f3886074ed.text: No use checking again in an hour, I won't change my mind.

f2-en-3240136ad70b.text: It's warm enough for shorts {WHEN}. Think about it, with {G} on top for now.

f2-en-3273d9ac51f2.text: The sweater can come off {WHEN}. || That could be the peak of your day.

f2-en-332e7c93fa63.text: Rain is possible {WHENP}, so maybe take the umbrella. || Grandpa's knee says rain too. I trust him.

f2-en-3355afc7d8f0.text: You can take {G} off {WHEN}. Even later on, you won't need {GP}.
f2-en-3355afc7d8f0.edit: You can take {G} off {WHEN}. You won't need {GP} for the rest of the day.

f2-en-33755ac5eb98.text: The heat stays all day, so keep water with you.

f2-en-34491a6acfa5.text: I'll hold this picture all night without using any power. Take that smartphone.

f2-en-349565d0f151.text: Another evening of you walking past me like I don't do anything.

f2-en-34e7d6a8c163.text: A cool start, then shorts weather {WHEN}.

f2-en-34f0b920d607.text: {WHEN} it's properly hot, so have water with you.
f2-en-34f0b920d607.edit: {WHEN} it's going to be really hot, so have water with you.

f2-en-34f95db5626e.text: You'll probably spend half of it choosing what to watch.

f2-en-354e434a77fa.text: Off, on. The layer gets more exercise than you.

f2-en-355153e0986e.text: This outfit is good all day. || You've already decided it isn't, haven't you.

f2-en-3556425973d1.text: The freezing rain stops {WHENSTOP}, but sidewalks may stay icy.

f2-en-35785e6016f4.text: The weather won't change for the rest of the evening. || You'll still blame it if your plans fall through.

f2-en-369302543d24.text: Same jacket, same route, same podcast. Living dangerously.
f2-en-369302543d24.edit: Same jacket, same route, same podcast. Living the dream.

f2-en-3694ad514172.text: Bring the winter coat. It gets colder {WHEN}.

f2-en-36b106f0eab0.text: {WHEN} the coat isn't enough on its own. Bring a scarf.

f2-en-3701a6ca4dea.text: Monday morning, and you're reading this before coffee. Bold.

f2-en-3765c45229e8.text: These are the clothes you're looking for.

f2-en-3798f6f69ba4.text: Try not to slip. I can't call anyone.

f2-en-37b9e5c3cd8a.text: Shame. It was just getting comfortable.

f2-en-37de62a158bb.text: No break from the heat today. Drink water, find shade. || And somehow you'll still burn the back of your neck.

f2-en-3828b2fcc1d1.text: Nothing to add or take off all day. || My shortest forecast, and my favorite.

f2-en-3828f82d15cb.text: It snows for a while still, then stops later.

f2-en-388cf8f2495b.text: Your jacket gets out more than you do.

f2-en-38f435c61a34.text: You'll forget to drink, then wonder where the headache came from.

f2-en-3970faba94bb.text: The thunderstorm passes {WHENSTOP}. Keep the umbrella until then.

f2-en-39dc69b8c4d7.text: Somebody cranked the outside too high. Wasn't me.

f2-en-3a838d13b674.text: You call this your good jacket. It's your only jacket.

f2-en-3aa6e73e195a.text: You'll leave it by the door anyway. I know you.

f2-en-3b7082cec610.text: {WHEN} it's warm enough for shorts, so think about putting some on now. || Very PE teacher of you. Still the right call.

f2-en-3b8ee6035e14.text: You're about to have strong opinions about air conditioning.

f2-en-3b98ca50cc94.text: And somehow you'll still burn the back of your neck.

f2-en-3bda7e275c65.text: Pack the umbrella. Rain sets in {WHENP} and doesn't let up. || Cows lie down before rain, apparently. I'd lie down too, if I could.

f2-en-3bfe29bc2590.text: It's freezing rain all day, so the sidewalks stay icy. Walk carefully and keep the umbrella with you.

f2-en-3c12f07c404e.text: What you're wearing works all day. || Now you just need somewhere to go in it.

f2-en-3c19c775ff66.text: No break from the heat today, so water and shade it is. || Thin, pale and cool. I was not made for this.

f2-en-3e1dd631f54f.text: You can wear this for the rest of the evening. || You were going to anyway.

f2-en-3ec5b7cae8df.text: For once, staying in with me is the sensible choice.

f2-en-3ef24f296919.text: Nothing changes for the rest of the evening. || Plenty of time to start something you won't finish.

f2-en-3f55194864a2.text: Later you'll say 'where did that come from?' From here. This morning.
f2-en-3f55194864a2.edit: Later you'll say 'where did that come from?' From right here.

f2-en-3f81e584b9b6.text: It could rain {WHENP}. Take the umbrella to be safe.

f2-en-3f89ddd7c739.text: Take the umbrella for now. The freezing rain stops later, but the sidewalks stay icy.

f2-en-40481521225f.text: Another day of umbrella chicken. You'll blink first.

f2-en-407e32fe96d4.text: Pi Day, because it's 3/14. You'll pretend you knew that.

f2-en-409cfe424667.text: Complaining it's warm, then that it isn't. You've got range.
f2-en-409cfe424667.note: doesn't work without the what's next images.

f2-en-40d252a20232.text: Freezing rain for now, then a break, then more {WHENP}. Keep the umbrella and mind the ice.
f2-en-40d252a20232.edit: Freezing rain for now, then a break, then more {WHENP}. Keep the umbrella and mind your steps.

f2-en-40f741e87081.text: I've never seen snow. Describe it to me later.
f2-en-40f741e87081.edit: I've never seen real snow. Describe it to me later.

f2-en-410c916039ed.text: All day. So no, you can't wait it out.

f2-en-4144bf6f66ba.text: You'll take the same photo out of the window as last year.

f2-en-415a17728f74.text: Bring the umbrella for the freezing rain now. It stops later, but the ice stays, so walk carefully.

f2-en-418b8fa82982.text: That ghosting on my screen? It's for Halloween.

f2-en-41a957f4be8a.text: Your Halloween costume is 'tired adult' again, isn't it.

f2-en-41cf664df635.text: It cools off a little {WHEN}, but stays warm. || A little. Don't get excited.

f2-en-41ea672d4538.text: Perfect for browsing flights somewhere warm and booking nothing. Again.

f2-en-41f96914db08.text: What you're wearing works until bed. || Whenever that is. I've stopped guessing.

f2-en-4227cb24a958.text: You can take the jacket off {WHEN}. || You'll announce 'it's actually warm' to people who are also outside.

f2-en-42412dfda857.text: The sun's lying to you. I'm not.

f2-en-429973679d85.text: The heat lasts all day. Keep water with you and stay in the shade.

f2-en-42ae1883634e.text: I've seen the afternoon. You haven't.

f2-en-42cc26ed1abd.text: Try to bring the umbrella home. Unlike the last three.
f2-en-42cc26ed1abd.edit: Try to bring this umbrella home with you. Unlike the last three.

f2-en-42ea587de389.text: Bring a jacket. It cools down {WHEN}.

f2-en-433a1f35970e.text: You checked the weather at this hour. For what, exactly?

f2-en-4356b724bb3e.text: My battery hates the cold too. We're bonding.
f2-en-4356b724bb3e.edit: My battery hates the cold too. Aww. Look at us, we're bonding!

f2-en-43a989ab295e.text: There's a chance of rain {WHENP}. An umbrella wouldn't hurt.

f2-en-43d3e74d949f.text: Trust me. I've never had cold legs.

f2-en-4433fc6c6773.text: You'll forget {GP}. Then you'll remember this moment.

f2-en-443d1560f4b8.text: The freezing rain stops {WHENSTOP}. Roads and sidewalks may stay icy, so walk carefully.

f2-en-44a5d92fc0e1.text: Snow moves in {WHENP}. || Finally, a reason to cancel the plans you were dreading.

f2-en-44cbd4e7cdc2.text: {WHENP} the rain sets in for good. Bring the umbrella. || 'For good' meaning today. I don't do forever.

f2-en-44ede405a9c0.text: Expect the cold to last all day.

f2-en-4514c21a52fe.text: Finally, a use for the fancy bottle you bought to drink more water.

f2-en-455909b7b466.text: It's cool now, but {WHEN} it's warm enough for shorts. || Your legs could use the daylight, frankly.

f2-en-456c9b6df4c1.text: Clocks changed back. You'll wake up early anyway and resent it.

f2-en-458ca3158b26.text: Later you'll pull {GP} on and say 'ah, that's better'. Out loud. You're welcome.

f2-en-45be25b3e769.text: It rains all day, so bring the umbrella. || All day. So no, waiting ten minutes won't help.

f2-en-45ca2bec087f.text: Merry Christmas. Unlike the tree, I'll still be up in February.

f2-en-45f79b76aaf8.text: Then be smug at everyone sheltering in doorways. You learned that from me.
f2-en-45f79b76aaf8.edit: Then you can be smug at everyone sheltering in doorways. I love the feeling.

f2-en-46315516f801.text: One short walk today, and we'll hear about it for weeks.

f2-en-4652ee2d2637.text: {G} comes off {WHEN}. It cools a little later, but you won't need {GP} back. || You'll want {GP} back. Wanting isn't needing.

f2-en-465a54e9923b.text: Once {G} comes off {WHEN}, you can leave {GP} off. || Leave {GP} off. Not 'leave {GP} somewhere'.

f2-en-46e283b30bc4.text: I've had firmware updates more exciting than today.

f2-en-470d5cd5f249.text: All that flashing. Some of us manage fine without a backlight.

f2-en-47411e772e1b.text: You can take {G} off {WHEN}. You'll want {GP} back {WHEN2}. || Then you'll say 'it's turned chilly' like it's news to you.

f2-en-479725ae5de7.text: Later the rain stops. For now, keep the umbrella with you.

f2-en-479e640095cc.text: Open it outside, please. I can't afford the bad luck.
f2-en-479e640095cc.edit: Open it outside, please. You can't afford the bad luck.

f2-en-47b0156eaca2.text: I'm very good for umbrella sales.

f2-en-47d12255ebd1.text: Thunder for now. The storm clears {WHENSTOP}.

f2-en-48e68f764c89.text: Rain is possible {WHENP}, so maybe take the umbrella. || I've done my bit. Now it's you versus the clouds.

f2-en-49a075c75068.text: Rain makes everything shiny. I stay tastefully matte.

f2-en-49a9e90b2853.text: It stays hot all day. Water and shade, please. || You'll say 'I'm not built for this' at least once. You're right.

f2-en-49d52dc482db.text: Today's weather has more mood swings than you. Barely.
f2-en-49d52dc482db.note: does not work in it's own without at least the what to wear next images.

f2-en-49e3c347c965.text: Easy day to forecast. I'll still take the credit.

f2-en-4a18bdfe7960.text: No layer to carry today. That means you have both hands free for snacks.

f2-en-4a82dbb83737.text: Monday morning. At least one of us is fully charged.

f2-en-4a9482e41eb7.text: Thrilling stuff. I'm on the edge of my frame.

f2-en-4abae13a7511.text: Someone has to stay sober and do the forecast.

f2-en-4b4c0567a2d7.text: Finally, a reason to cancel the plans you were dreading.

f2-en-4b6d5b32c02b.text: You're dressed right for the rest of the evening. || Plenty of evening left for not answering that message.

f2-en-4baa72c8395d.text: I'd lend you some warmth, but I run cool on principle.

f2-en-4c88311cc5a6.text: The rain starts {WHENP} and doesn't stop. Bring the umbrella. || It has more stamina than you. Most things do.

f2-en-4c8a874a1012.text: Longest day of the year and you'll still say you ran out of time.

f2-en-4e0a4d576fa1.text: Snow moves in {WHENP}. || The one forecast that makes adults text each other in capital letters.

f2-en-4e36c6ca8931.text: The snow keeps coming all day.

f2-en-4e40c1e8a61a.text: There's a thunderstorm {WHENP}. Take the umbrella.

f2-en-4edd44b2880e.text: It warms up {WHEN}, so the scarf can come off.

f2-en-500a6e713332.text: Everyone still remembers the last time you didn't.

f2-en-501c56bed877.text: {G} can come off {WHEN}, and you won't need {GP} again today.

f2-en-508e435165ba.text: You'll walk on the untouched bits first. Don't pretend you won't.

f2-en-50d41f988c5a.text: You're fine as you are for the rest of the evening. || Rare words from me. Enjoy them.

f2-en-50dbea5ab1d7.text: 'Proper snow,' you'll say. As if there's improper snow.

f2-en-512f8eef6754.text: Take a bottle of water. The heat arrives {WHEN}.

f2-en-5137338d37d1.text: You'll doubt me for the first hour. Then you won't admit I was right.

f2-en-51ca2373115a.text: You'll keep the coat on inside for ten minutes, 'just to warm up'.

f2-en-51fd896bea3e.text: {G} can come off {WHEN}, but you'll want {GP} back {WHEN2}. || Fifty-fifty {GP} goes missing in between.

f2-en-52194c7824be.text: Bring a jacket. It cools down {WHEN}. || You'll put it on later and act like it was your idea.

f2-en-52643a2e8a60.text: Shorts weather arrives {WHEN}, so think about wearing shorts now and keep {G} just for the start.

f2-en-526b017fcbf7.text: It's this cold the whole day.

f2-en-52de38d0fcc2.text: Bring it back, too. I'm keeping count.

f2-en-52e1b65d4f61.text: Very PE teacher of you. Still the right call.

f2-en-52f245874cc5.text: Don't fall. I have no way of getting help.

f2-en-532267e1a960.text: {WHEN} it gets cool enough for a jacket.

f2-en-5327b5c8d398.text: Sunny days, you walk right past me. I've stopped taking it personally. Mostly.

f2-en-5369478a66e4.text: {G} can come off {WHEN}. {WHEN2} you'll want {GP} back, plus an extra layer.

f2-en-53825d8fe017.text: Rain for now, then a dry spell, then more rain {WHENP}. The umbrella stays with you.

f2-en-53c7c88e97a2.text: What you're wearing works all day. || Longest commitment you'll make this week.

f2-en-54a1b5d45f07.text: You'll find shade, then complain it's the wrong shade.

f2-en-54a28bbbb464.text: Drink water often and stay in the shade. Today's heat is dangerous, especially at midday.

f2-en-54c75236f0a1.text: Take {G} off {WHEN}, put {GP} back on {WHEN2}. || Off and on again. That fixes most things, me included.

f2-en-56a2069355ca.text: {WHENP} it starts to snow. || Every sled in the neighborhood just got its hopes up.
f2-en-56a2069355ca.edit: {WHENP} it starts to snow. || Every kid in the neighborhood just got its hopes up.

f2-en-579801b066fa.text: Take the umbrella. The rain keeps going all day.

f2-en-57f05deaea3b.text: The rain and thunder stop later, but you'll want the umbrella for now.

f2-en-592aa732ae19.text: It's hot all day: keep water with you and stay in the shade. || Not me, thanks. Water and I don't get along.

f2-en-59603ccd2237.text: Bring a jacket. It cools down {WHEN}. || That's your one reminder. I don't do push notifications.

f2-en-59775dcfa180.text: If you're late, blame the ice. It's the one excuse I'll back.

f2-en-599e5ed3f798.text: Everything out there just went black and white. Welcome to my world.

f2-en-5b2427a8058e.text: What you're wearing works for the rest of the evening. || Whatever the evening brings, the outfit won't be the problem.
f2-en-5b2427a8058e.edit: What you're wearing works for the rest of the evening. || So whatever the evening brings, your outfit won't be the problem.

f2-en-5b7b653d56ec.text: You might get some rain {WHENP}, so the umbrella could come in handy.

f2-en-5bc4debb1ed7.text: It's hot all day, so drink water and stay in the shade. || You'll manage the shade. The water, we'll see.

f2-en-5cfaa92e1d64.text: A thunderstorm comes {WHENP}, after a short dry spell. Keep the umbrella close.

f2-en-5d2b4d1a0296.text: {WHEN} {G} can come off. {WHEN2} you'll need {GP} again, and something warm on top.

f2-en-5d71c4d16db2.text: {WHEN} you can do without the winter coat. || You'll miss the pockets, though.

f2-en-5dbf4bb4ce45.text: Nothing changes tonight. || You'll scroll in bed for an hour and call it winding down.

f2-en-5dcd5aac8f7f.text: {WHEN} a jacket won't be enough, so bring the winter coat. || The jacket will try. Bless it.

f2-en-5dec85e894b9.text: Or keep {GP} on out of loyalty and quietly cook.

f2-en-5e255a8cf628.text: Monday. I don't do weekends, so I don't see what the fuss is about.
f2-en-5e255a8cf628.edit: I don't do weekends, so I don't get what the fuss is about.

f2-en-5e359144b3b4.text: Today needs nothing more than what you have on. || A rare thing for me to say about anyone.

f2-en-5f0cc2d44e0c.text: Somewhere a screen is showing a Monet. And all you get is this.

f2-en-5f0f911d0fbf.text: Nothing to change tonight. What you have on is right.
f2-en-5f0f911d0fbf.edit: Nothing to change tonight. What you have on is perfect.

f2-en-5f3c0f7bc640.text: Try not to get stuck halfway, arms up. I can't come and help.

f2-en-5f75f86bcbb4.text: Take the umbrella for now. The thunderstorm passes later.

f2-en-5fd4f1764075.text: The sun's on half days until February. Must be nice.

f2-en-5fe325fae6af.text: I don't need beauty sleep. Clearly.

f2-en-5fe91f6e7782.text: It stays hot all day, so bring water and look for shade.

f2-en-603f81b1fee0.text: This outfit works all day. || The one forecast I could do in my sleep.

f2-en-6070e1ba70f1.text: And there's plenty of it. It's been dark since about four.

f2-en-60c4fbc6f838.text: Walk like you're carrying a very full cup of coffee. Graceful is optional. Upright isn't.

f2-en-6107b9bf1220.text: It's cold all day. || My only weakness is the cold. Kidding, I don't have one.

f2-en-61ae015adfaf.text: If you stay in, I'll act like I didn't notice.

f2-en-624c84b704bd.text: Carrying a layer you don't need yet. How very grown-up.

f2-en-6321aa8b184e.text: Reading this slowly won't make it any warmer.

f2-en-633aa175a774.text: Leave {GP} behind and you'll think of me later. Not fondly.

f2-en-638ad3c75283.text: I've never once slipped on ice. Never left the house, either.

f2-en-63fbee955055.text: The rain stops for a while, then a thunderstorm comes {WHENP}. Keep the umbrella with you.

f2-en-644d42ec269c.text: You'll probably end up loitering in the freezer aisle. Again.

f2-en-644e14ba78c9.text: You'll say it's not that cold. Your face will disagree.

f2-en-6466ace3c734.text: Some relief from the heat {WHEN}, but it stays warm. || I'll take the credit for that. Nobody else will.
f2-en-6466ace3c734.edit: Some relief from the heat {WHEN}, but it stays warm. || I'll take the credit for that.
