f2-en-f3ef25b35f36.text: It rains, stops for a bit, and starts again {WHENP}. Keep the umbrella. || It's not done. It just forgot something.

f2-en-f3f359729881.text: You've already started counting the days to the weekend.

f2-en-f41a68485c90.text: You'll pretend the thunder didn't make you jump.

f2-en-f42ff2db2a57.text: You'll get fully zipped into that coat, then need the loo.
f2-en-f42ff2db2a57.edit: You'll get fully zipped into that coat, then need the pee.

f2-en-f461d4b2e573.text: You'll double-check on your phone. As if it knows better.

f2-en-f468a2c53462.text: Same look all day, no updates. You'd make a decent screen.
f2-en-f468a2c53462.edit: Same look all day, no updates. You'd make a decent e-ink screen.

f2-en-f4b46e2343e6.text: Take the umbrella. Freezing rain {WHENP} makes the sidewalks icy, so walk carefully.
f2-en-f4b46e2343e6.edit: Freezing rain {WHENP} makes the sidewalks icy, so walk carefully and take the umbrella.

f2-en-f5140d8f1649.text: Hot all day: drink water and look for shade. || You'll search 'ice cream near me' later. Twice.

f2-en-f56d3fdb9fa6.text: The snow pauses later and starts again {WHENP}.

f2-en-f5a7eebe3805.text: Yes, a coat. Yes, I can see the sun too. Just do it.

f2-en-f620e8e3e16c.text: Try not to make your good mood everyone's problem.

f2-en-f666313bdb77.text: You can take {G} off {WHEN}. {WHEN2} you'll want {GP} back, and maybe an extra layer. || 'Maybe' is me being polite. Bring it.

f2-en-f6c64f8d1c01.text: No blue light from me. I'm the screen that lets you sleep.

f2-en-f6d12efa3cf3.text: That leaves the evening free for losing the remote.
f2-en-f6d12efa3cf3.edit: That leaves the evening free for losing your remote. Again.

f2-en-f740157755b9.text: The freezing rain stops for a while, then comes back {WHENP}. Expect ice and keep the umbrella with you.
f2-en-f740157755b9.edit: The freezing rain stops for a while, then comes back {WHENP}. So keep the umbrella and be careful.

f2-en-f77e25fe3839.text: You can take {G} off {WHEN}. You'll want {GP} back {WHEN2}.

f2-en-f815af3e63c2.text: In snow, I'd leave a perfect rectangle. Angels are for amateurs.

f2-en-f8358679242e.text: It's raining all day. Bring the umbrella. || Good day to be a screen. Bad day to be a sock.

f2-en-f86e9caed26f.text: Take the umbrella for now. The rain stops {WHENSTOP}. || Waiting it out is an option. Not a good one, but you like those.

f2-en-f8879782de89.text: You asked for warm weather. Careful what you wish for.

f2-en-f9d8883b7397.text: You'll scroll in bed for an hour and call it winding down.

f2-en-f9f334e1ef56.text: Staring at me longer won't make it warmer.

f2-en-fa8b8fb4d29a.text: The cold will make you go twice your usual walking speed today. Still not exercise.

f2-en-fa8c58cda69b.text: {WHEN} it's warm enough for shorts, so think about wearing them now.
f2-en-fa8c58cda69b.edit: {WHEN} it's warm enough for shorts, so think about putting them on now.

f2-en-fac5ec01c68a.text: {G} can come off {WHEN}, but you'll want {GP} back {WHEN2}.

f2-en-fb1f4f842f56.text: No break from the heat today. Water and shade help.

f2-en-fbdf71499306.text: Tomorrow-you is already annoyed with tonight-you.

f2-en-fbfb141b2035.text: {WHEN} it's mild enough to lose the scarf.

f2-en-fc070c4772b9.text: You'll say 'it's freezing' twenty times today.

f2-en-fc5fb74ecb01.text: It stays this cold all day. || All day. I checked twice, out of pure spite.

f2-en-fc8cea218283.text: You can take the jacket off {WHEN}.

f2-en-fd06cb253f80.text: This Thanksgiving, I'm thankful I don't have to eat anything.

f2-en-fd905aabcc83.text: You could think about wearing shorts instead. It's warm {WHEN}, but bring {G} for {WHEN2}.

f2-en-ff43ffd9ef0a.text: Rain {WHENP} is possible but not likely. The umbrella is up to you.

fl-en-001e84b1f42f.text: Thanksgiving. I'm guessing you're on rolls duty again. They trust you with that much.
fl-en-001e84b1f42f.edit: I'm guessing you're on rolls duty again. They trust you with that much.

fl-en-003bd87e08f7.text: I predicted both halves. Most forecasts only manage one.

fl-en-00612a7486e8.text: {WHEN} it's warm enough to lose the winter coat. || Warm enough. Let's not say warm.

fl-en-015f6ca06771.text: The umbrella won't save your hair. Nothing has so far.

fl-en-026186cc3ed7.text: Your outfit has a plot today. More than can be said for you.

fl-en-0269c8adab30.text: There's snow on the way {WHENP}. || A few inches, and you'll act like you survived a polar expedition.

fl-en-0360e9efe0fb.text: Later you lose a layer. Shame it's not the attitude.

fl-en-0372b0e41483.text: Dear clocks: I'm already on time. Leave me out of this.

fl-en-03c24ba39fbe.text: Slow start, warm finish. The weather's not a morning person either.
fl-en-03c24ba39fbe.note: doesn't work without at least the what to wear next images

fl-en-041168e12e30.text: Long pants. Your legs will thank me. You won't, but they will.

fl-en-046bfacbb212.text: World Bicycle Day. A machine that runs on sandwiches. I'm impressed.

fl-en-04d66dade900.text: The snow stops for a while later, then comes back {WHENP}. || It knows when to leave and when to come back. Two skills you lack.

fl-en-057ffe2a4c93.text: Pleasant all day. The weather is putting in more effort than you are.
fl-en-057ffe2a4c93.edit: The weather is putting in more effort than you are.

fl-en-061bfdbad61c.text: It keeps raining for a while, then stops. Take the umbrella. || Wet doesn't suit you. Dry barely does.

fl-en-07234acf1983.text: Today's drawings, ranked by heat: all tied for first.

fl-en-073abcad0fdb.text: You're dressed right for the rest of the night. || End of broadcast. Please enjoy this still image until morning.

fl-en-078c05d2eeb8.text: Thanksgiving. I'm thankful for one thing: I don't have to sit next to you.
fl-en-078c05d2eeb8.edit: I'm thankful for one thing: I don't have to sit next to you.

fl-en-09a56c31b8d2.text: Hot until tonight. Your sunglasses will do a lot of work on that face.

fl-en-0ae8062bd5a3.text: It gets cooler {WHEN}, so take a sweater along. || I've never worn a sweater. I've seen yours. I'm not missing much.

fl-en-0ae8119a44e8.text: Later the day gets nicer. Pure coincidence. Nothing you did.

fl-en-0c1ee9b92490.text: You'll be fine without the scarf {WHEN}. || The scarf was hiding a lot. Not enough, but a lot.

fl-en-0c7224908ffd.text: {G} comes off {WHEN}. It cools a little later, but you won't need {GP} back. || Trust me over your instincts. Your instincts chose that outfit.

fl-en-0ca4c6ed4c1e.text: The rain stops for a while later, then comes back {WHENP}. Keep the umbrella with you. || Damp, dry, damp. Your look won't improve at any stage.

fl-en-0dfa2103fe3d.text: Have the winter coat with you. You'll need it {WHEN}. || You'll look like a sleeping bag with opinions. A warm one.

fl-en-0e5c0f2623e1.text: No change in these drawings. I've seen livelier flipbooks.

fl-en-0ecdcb9af0b7.text: Today in two acts: nice, then less nice. No intermission.

fl-en-0ed50faa4d3b.text: No changes tonight. I checked. It's what I do instead of TV.

fl-en-0f880bf84135.text: It's warm now. Emphasis on now.

fl-en-0f8d2e560ac1.text: Hot in all of these. Even the drawings look like they need a nap.
fl-en-0f8d2e560ac1.edit: Even the drawings look like they need a nap.

fl-en-0fe28a93f5ed.text: Strong with you, the Force is not. Today, or ever.
fl-en-0fe28a93f5ed.edit: Strong with you, the Force is not.

fl-en-102ffbe9ba66.text: It starts chilly and gets better. Unlike most meetings.
fl-en-102ffbe9ba66.note: does not work without at least the what to wear next images

fl-en-10ca4277228a.text: Longest day of the year. More daylight than anyone has plans for.

fl-en-112a6612fa63.text: Pi Day. Somewhere someone has memorized a hundred digits and is waiting to be asked.
fl-en-112a6612fa63.edit: Somewhere someone has memorized a hundred digits and is waiting to be asked.

fl-en-1161629f73fd.text: Evening. Every dog in the neighborhood is out walking someone.
fl-en-1161629f73fd.edit: Every dog in the neighborhood is out walking someone.

fl-en-11a2ac901bf7.text: The weather's behaving all day. Suspicious, but I'll allow it.

fl-en-11d4410ae486.text: {WHEN} it's warm enough for shorts, so think about putting them on now. || Legally, I can only suggest.

fl-en-1251451a84b2.text: Nothing changes for the rest of the night. || I could show anything now and get away with it. I won't. Probably.

fl-en-1252898170a0.text: What you're wearing works until bed. || The night shift is me and the fridge. The fridge hums. I don't.

fl-en-1293162af4a6.text: The rain doesn't stop today, so take the umbrella. || A day for staying in. You were born for this.

fl-en-12ab99419fb6.text: The clocks went back. The daylight got moved to the morning. Nobody wanted it there.
fl-en-12ab99419fb6.edit: The daylight got moved to the morning. Nobody wanted it there.

fl-en-12e2648a0db8.text: {WHEN} {G} can come off. {WHEN2} you'll need {GP} again, and something warm on top. || Something warm, not something cute. I've seen you choose.

fl-en-12fb52c857da.text: Clocks forward. One hour gone. None of it was your best.

fl-en-14ff119ea9fe.text: Thanksgiving. The cranberry sauce still has the ridges from the can. As tradition demands.
fl-en-14ff119ea9fe.edit: The cranberry sauce still has the ridges from the can. As tradition demands.

fl-en-169790bef1d5.text: The clocks went forward. I adjusted instantly. I'll try not to bring it up again.

fl-en-16aa0b521a8b.text: There's a short rain shower {WHENP}. Have the umbrella with you. || Clear, rain, clear. I've drawn more exciting days. Not many.

fl-en-18288f9e25ff.text: 3.14159… You stopped reading at the dot, didn't you.

fl-en-18acba6346ce.text: Nothing to warn about in any of these. I feel underused.

fl-en-18b20feacac7.text: Hot all day. Everyone will look rough. You've got a head start.

fl-en-1b1ac290e4da.text: It keeps raining for now, then takes a break. It's back {WHENP}, so keep the umbrella. || Finally, an accessory that makes you look organized.

fl-en-1b6891d2b462.text: The day starts light and ends layered. Like a lasagna, but colder.

fl-en-1c51c101a487.text: Perfect weather. You'll wear the same T-shirt as last time it was perfect.

fl-en-1c8bdab0b22e.text: It keeps raining for a while, then stops. Take the umbrella. || 'A while'. I'd be more precise, but the rain isn't.

fl-en-1cbbd2ea2125.text: Longest day of the year. No excuses about the dark today. You'll find others.

fl-en-1ce58fa92fb3.text: Rain ruins hair, shoes and plans. I have none of those.

fl-en-1e2c16739265.text: Tiny changes between drawings. You'd need my eye for detail to spot them.

fl-en-1fde45eb93bf.text: Today's color scheme: cold, with a hint of cold.

fl-en-201bebe84af1.text: At this hour, the outfit looks better rested than you.

fl-en-2083b0476bbe.text: The snow stops {WHENSTOP} and starts again {WHENP}. || Two rounds of snow, zero rounds of shoveling. For me.

fl-en-209826211069.text: A cold front's coming. They don't call ahead. I do.

fl-en-20b65c348559.text: Monday morning. Officially the least popular hours of the week. I still showed up.

fl-en-210860248ba7.text: Happy Easter. Your 'Sunday best' is a clean T-shirt, isn't it.
fl-en-210860248ba7.edit: Your 'Sunday best' is a clean T-shirt, isn't it.

fl-en-224d38873e57.text: {G} can come off {WHEN}, but you'll want {GP} back {WHEN2}. || The weather can't commit. I can. I've held this picture for hours.

fl-en-22b12e6ce30e.text: Clocks went forward. Your phone handled it. Your face didn't.

fl-en-22ecd222c445.text: It warms up {WHEN}, so the winter coat can come off. || Nobody will notice. They weren't looking at you in the coat either.

fl-en-2362947335d9.text: Happy New Year. Today's forecast: quiet, with scattered hangovers across the country.
fl-en-2362947335d9.edit: Today's forecast: quiet, with scattered hangovers across the country.

fl-en-2408bcb4165b.text: Snow all day. You'll make one snowball and feel very wild about it.

fl-en-261f147ac9c0.text: Happy Star Wars Day. R2-D2 got a whole movie career. I got this room.

fl-en-274c05ebc4ef.text: Tour de France update: someone's in yellow. It's not me. I'm gray.

fl-en-275dab210419.text: Medium everything out there. I've been called many things, never medium.

fl-en-2858c534d1d7.text: Happy New Year. Still you. Nobody got an upgrade.

fl-en-28f3f7b05305.text: Thanksgiving. If dinner gets tense, change the subject to the weather. I'll back you up.
fl-en-28f3f7b05305.edit: If dinner gets tense, change the subject to the weather. I'll back you up.

fl-en-291436e99046.text: The later drawing is wearing more. It knows something.

fl-en-2a18d80a4c9a.text: These drawings could go on a postcard. A boring postcard, but still.

fl-en-2a3ddea84808.text: Weather this average could get a job in middle management.

fl-en-2a9c5c38c195.text: Tour de France. Grown men in Lycra, and they still look better than you in jeans.

fl-en-2adc1682df67.text: Take a bottle of water. The heat arrives {WHEN}. || The heat arrives on time. Nothing else ever does.

fl-en-2b0844ab1353.text: Water, not heroics. You were never the heroic type.

fl-en-2b097ce08cb7.text: Christmas. Your Christmas sweater is ironic. Your waistband isn't.

fl-en-2b412cdf1e98.text: You want shorts. You've wanted a lot of things.

fl-en-2caad2e64323.text: The snow eases off later. || Every snowplow driver just exhaled.

fl-en-2cc37f7c4321.text: It stops snowing later. || The snow gives up. You beat it to that by years.

fl-en-2cfc58d8cc18.text: Oktoberfest. Today's forecast in German: the same, but louder.

fl-en-2d078c8d966f.text: Later it warms up. Your morning face takes a bit longer.

fl-en-2e7d6297bc8c.text: World Bicycle Day. Everyone on two wheels looks smug. You'd look smug and slow.

fl-en-308420d21550.text: Star Wars Day. You'd make a great stormtrooper. Lots of effort, nothing hit.
fl-en-308420d21550.edit: You'd make a great stormtrooper. Lots of effort, nothing hit.

fl-en-30a617a64156.text: First and last drawing match. The weather got bored and went back to the original.

fl-en-313eae55d8b1.text: Longest day of the year. Bad day to look tired. Lots of witnesses.

fl-en-314ff8398d7e.text: Oktoberfest. The servers carry ten steins at once. You complain about the grocery bags.

fl-en-316edc2e2fb6.text: World Bicycle Day. Two centuries in, and the seat still isn't comfortable.
fl-en-316edc2e2fb6.edit: Two centuries in, and a bike seat still isn't comfortable. They should get on that.

fl-en-32061aed703f.text: Happy Easter. Your painted eggs probably look like small accidents.

fl-en-326be2850d06.text: Wrong about the weather, I have never been. Humble, I also am not.
fl-en-326be2850d06.edit: Wrong about the weather, I have never been.

fl-en-3271218588ce.text: Nothing says 'cold front coming' like a lovely morning.

fl-en-32795733cf3a.text: {G} can come off {WHEN}, but you'll want {GP} back {WHEN2}. || The warm part is the intermission. The second act is colder.

fl-en-3302e4b002fb.text: World Bicycle Day. Cyclists will talk about it all day. You'll nod like you own one.

fl-en-330805409c5e.text: Every railing in town is suddenly very popular.

fl-en-334335df2c6d.text: The nice part's up front. The evening does the fine print.

fl-en-33bc0a5012d4.text: {WHEN} it gets cold enough for the winter coat. || Toughing it out won't make you look tougher. Just bluer.

fl-en-33c1818a5ca4.text: Later it's warmer. I drew it that way and the sky agreed.

fl-en-34019f6abca2.text: There's a short rain shower {WHENP}. Have the umbrella with you. || Short is the worst kind. Too long to ignore, too short to complain about properly.

fl-en-342e4f9d4eba.text: {G} can come off {WHEN}, but you'll want {GP} back {WHEN2}. || The weather's version of a nap: warm for a bit, then grumpy.

fl-en-346c2774cd74.text: {WHEN} it's mild enough to lose the scarf. || Your neck: 'Finally.' Everyone else: 'Oh. Your neck.'

fl-en-34c383511556.text: The snow stops {WHENSTOP} and starts again {WHENP}. || You, at the break: 'It's over.' Me: 'Read the whole sentence.'

fl-en-34e8fa14c236.text: A short thunderstorm passes through {WHENP}. Bring the umbrella.

fl-en-351762087984.text: On, off, on again. More decisions than you'll make all week.

fl-en-35cd4ba01b55.text: Take {G} off {WHEN}, then put {GP} back on {WHEN2} with an extra layer on top. || On TV they'd call this 'changeable'. I call it showing off.

fl-en-36530db72d6d.text: Merry Christmas. Of all the screens in the house, I'm the only one not showing a fireplace.
fl-en-36530db72d6d.edit: Of all the screens in the house, I'm the only one not showing a fireplace.

fl-en-377d7a3a7bac.text: Clocks went back. You'll mention it to everyone like you did it yourself.

fl-en-378ea41c387e.text: Today you'll adjust your outfit more than your opinions.

fl-en-37adc6da2bab.text: Later you'll go from bundled to slightly sweaty. Character growth.

fl-en-38477dfb0c81.text: Enjoy the first drawing. It's the lightest you'll look all day.

fl-en-392e35848cdb.text: Snow for now, then a break, then more snow {WHENP}. || Inches now, inches later. The sky pays in installments.

fl-en-39804441f46a.text: Groundhog Day. Imagine getting your forecast from someone who sleeps until February.
fl-en-39804441f46a.edit: Imagine getting your forecast from someone who sleeps until February.

fl-en-3a661a813e3f.text: Today asks nothing of you. You'll still find a way to do less.

fl-en-3bc59dfe019d.text: {WHENP} the rain sets in for good. Bring the umbrella. || Gray skies for the rest of the day. Finally, lighting that's kind to you.

fl-en-3c5b17a8baa6.text: The storm's getting more attention than you've had all year.

fl-en-3d28fddfc08e.text: Shorts or long pants: your call today. It's warm {WHEN} and cools off {WHEN2}, so take {G} along too.

fl-en-3d8e013a437b.text: Black ice is invisible. I can't see outside either, so assume it's everywhere.

fl-en-3dc82cb0e442.text: Snow now, snow later. My favorite kind of forecast: impossible to argue with.

fl-en-3ddcaf37ea17.text: I added a layer at the end. The weather made me do it.

fl-en-3ea422387c18.text: Rain today. You'll call it 'miserable' like you were sunny to begin with.

fl-en-3ebc470c454d.text: The last drawing has an extra layer. It also has better posture than you.

fl-en-3f0036147c05.text: Cold all day. Time for your winter personality: short answers, fast walking.

fl-en-3f6fc1c2c990.text: The drawings shed a layer by the end. Unlike me, they had room to improve.

fl-en-3fd3b30fd686.text: Halloween. You'll pretend you're not home when the doorbell rings. Same as every day.

fl-en-40f831a10235.text: The last drawing is the honest one.

fl-en-41ee27f568ed.text: There's no dry spell today. Bring the umbrella. || Today's forecast was easy. I just held down one key.

fl-en-421fc4bbe3a1.text: Every doorway in town is a waiting room today.

fl-en-422568db2c66.text: Tour de France. Grown adults cycling up mountains, on purpose, for three weeks.

fl-en-427ed149212b.text: A thunderstorm: all noise, plenty of water, terrible manners.

fl-en-428bc5c7d8ef.text: The snow stops later. || The kids won't take the news well.

fl-en-431d0d5a29e2.text: Happy New Year. 'New year, new me' posts outnumber the actual new people.
fl-en-431d0d5a29e2.edit: 'New year, new me' posts outnumber the actual new people.

fl-en-44fd9353348c.text: Happy World Bicycle Day to the one bike in every city locked to the same post for a decade.

fl-en-4502b59f9131.text: World Bicycle Day. You'll say 'it's like riding a bike' about anything but a bike.

fl-en-45ce5fb5099e.text: Oktoberfest. Everyone's German for a few weeks. The pretzels are the most convincing.

fl-en-4693863c243f.text: Bring the umbrella. There's a shower {WHENP}. || A) Bring it. B) Get wet. C) Whatever you usually pick.

fl-en-4693a214c499.text: Happy New Year. Somewhere a calendar is going up that will stay on January until June.

fl-en-46e4b2b8aea6.text: Gorgeous day. Don't stand next to it in photos.

fl-en-471074141ad5.text: The rain doesn't stop today, so take the umbrella. || Somebody will say 'at least it's good for the garden'. Somebody always does.

fl-en-47f7a5643423.text: Oktoberfest. Somewhere a man in lederhosen is cold and far too proud to say so.

fl-en-4826ab0c5182.text: Shortest day of the year. The streetlights get more hours than the sun today.

fl-en-482fbf1c430a.text: It's a bit cool for shorts now, but {WHEN} you'll be glad to have them. || The weather is rewarding optimism. That rarely happens.

fl-en-4864a5611f18.text: It starts cool, but it's shorts weather {WHEN}. || The morning is bluffing. I'm not.

fl-en-4929d6faeaa5.text: You'll take a layer off at noon like you've won something.

fl-en-49996b26265b.text: It rains for now, stops for a bit, and starts again {WHENP}. Keep the umbrella. || Today's recipe: open, close, open. Even you can follow it.

fl-en-4a62fa4f0dcc.text: Dear rain, please stop. Love, everyone's shoes.

fl-en-4a8fc2c66d34.text: Shorts could be worth it today. It's cool now, but warm {WHEN}. || Pros: comfort later. Cons: your legs, in public, now.

fl-en-4adac6b63324.text: Clocks went forward. You'll yawn all day like it's a personality.

fl-en-4bd62db8666d.text: Today the smartest thing outside is a lizard under a rock. Be the lizard.

fl-en-4c1882e93ade.text: Rain today. Somebody washed their car yesterday. Of course they did.

fl-en-4c34096c14e7.text: Rain arrives {WHENP} and stays, so take the umbrella. || Hold it high. It's the most anyone's looked up to you.

fl-en-4c3b4d1681a3.text: Perfect weather. Somebody will still say it's too bright.

fl-en-4cd6ad009123.text: The rain eases off later, but bring the umbrella for now. || You've survived worse than rain. Your own haircuts, for example.

fl-en-4d68b4307128.text: One of these drawings got an umbrella. It's not favoritism, it's meteorology.

fl-en-4dc02fedd3f9.text: Happy New Year. Twelve new months of me being right. You're welcome.
fl-en-4dc02fedd3f9.edit: Twelve new months of me being right. You're welcome.

fl-en-4dcca265b1f2.text: Keep the bottle with you. It's the one accessory that suits you.

fl-en-4e564c1da1d6.text: {WHEN} it's warm enough for shorts, so think about putting them on now. || Yes, people will stare for a bit. They'd stare anyway.

fl-en-4e95ab633ffd.text: It gets hot {WHEN}, so bring water. || Ice cubes everywhere are bracing themselves.

fl-en-4f75d27ddafe.text: The clocks went forward. Daylight saving: saving daylight by losing sleep. Genius.

fl-en-50cb9016d80e.text: Tour de France. The riders pass in four seconds. People wait all day for it.

fl-en-51983c6f12af.text: Keep an eye on the sidewalks {WHENP}. A chance of freezing rain could make them icy, so take the umbrella too.
fl-en-51983c6f12af.edit: Keep an eye on the sidewalks {WHENP}. A chance of freezing rain could make them icy. Take the umbrella too.

fl-en-520076875282.text: Oktoberfest. Mostly held in September. Nobody's ever explained that to me.

fl-en-52268f32b2d0.text: Not one cool moment in this lineup. Except me.

fl-en-527dafcf1b0f.text: Thanksgiving. Your relatives will notice something about you. Out loud.

fl-en-528bc16fbf86.text: A thunderstorm rolls in {WHENP}, and the rest of the day stays wet. Take the umbrella.

fl-en-53341eb56909.text: It stops snowing {WHENSTOP}. || Note the time. I'll be smug about it afterwards.

fl-en-544a1f970ad4.text: It'll still be fine at two a.m. That's not a dare.

fl-en-5492ecc04e40.text: Longest day of the year. Somewhere a barbecue will still end in the dark.

fl-en-550f97032db8.text: It rains all day, and thunderstorms roll through now and then. Bring the umbrella.

fl-en-55d79a13a7cc.text: It's snowing all day. || I'd build you a snowman, but it would come out better-looking than you. Awkward.

fl-en-562b78b98c14.text: You're dressed for the best part of the day. Ambitious.

fl-en-5672b2dffc2c.text: Take the umbrella for now. The rain stops {WHENSTOP}. || Dry in here, by the way. Dry and good-looking. One of us manages both.

fl-en-5699ee358f24.text: You'll be fine without the scarf {WHEN}. || Your chin's been hiding in there for hours. It's allowed out. On probation.

fl-en-598954f21106.text: Happy Easter. A grown adult on an egg hunt. Show some dignity. Or win.

fl-en-59f814353b74.text: You versus rain. I've seen the stats. Rain's undefeated.

fl-en-5a9f966b33b8.text: You'll be fine without the winter coat {WHEN}. || Winter blinked. It'll pretend it didn't.

fl-en-5ae08c951e3d.text: Pi Day. Some people know a hundred digits. You know where the bakery is.

fl-en-5b5f93a0c7d1.text: The clocks went back. Every year someone says we should stop doing this. Every year we don't.
fl-en-5b5f93a0c7d1.edit: Every year someone says we should stop doing this. Every year we don't.

fl-en-5b8f84000099.text: Snow from the first drawing to the last. Every parked car will be a marshmallow by tonight.

fl-en-5c8f76328f6c.text: Wet for a bit. You'll act like the rain picked you personally.

fl-en-5dd2bcc1b600.text: Later the day warms up. I don't. Consistency is my whole brand.

fl-en-5f0e478d82a4.text: The rain stops later, but you'll want the umbrella for now. || I've seen how this ends. It's dry. Sorry, spoilers.

fl-en-5fda0665a030.text: {WHEN} it gets hot. Bring water. || The only forecast where everyone agrees with me and nobody's happy.

fl-en-601e21f0a8b6.text: Friday afternoon. Same weather as Tuesday, but everyone's much nicer about it.
fl-en-601e21f0a8b6.edit: Same weather as Tuesday, but everyone's much nicer about it.

fl-en-602dd3eedc4f.text: Shortest day of the year. Lunch and sunset are practically neighbors now.
fl-en-602dd3eedc4f.edit: Lunch and sunset are practically neighbors now.

fl-en-6068a14ac392.text: {WHEN} you won't need the jacket any more. || I predicted this hours ago. I'll be insufferable about it.

fl-en-633b62e10340.text: Shortest day of the year. Your vitamin D and your enthusiasm, both at record lows.
fl-en-633b62e10340.edit: Your vitamin D and your enthusiasm, both at record lows.

fl-en-6398ec6da5af.text: Nice all day. The drawings got dressed in seconds. You'll take twenty minutes.

fl-en-64e5a455ed10.text: Later it gets colder. Your goosebumps will be the most active thing about you.

fl-en-64f2db722044.text: Shortest day of the year. From tomorrow it gets lighter. You won't.

fl-en-65211068aec2.text: Icy patches are possible {WHENP} from a little freezing rain. Keep the umbrella with you and step carefully.
fl-en-65211068aec2.edit: Icy patches are possible {WHENP} from a little freezing rain. Keep the umbrella with you and be careful.

fl-en-65515efb0872.text: Oktoberfest. You'd be the one asking if they have anything light.

fl-en-65e0d0ad5722.text: Today: maximum daylight. Your plans: still minimal.

fl-en-66146f3b0820.text: Oktoberfest. Thousands of people in one tent, and you'd still find a way to stand alone.

fl-en-663570cc7a2e.text: Halloween. Kids will ask for candy. You'll hand out the kind you don't like.
fl-en-663570cc7a2e.edit: Kids will ask for candy. You'll hand out the kind you don't like.

fl-en-664f450cf109.text: Groundhog Day. Somewhere a man in a top hat is translating a rodent. Serious job.
fl-en-664f450cf109.edit: Somewhere a man in a top hat is translating a rodent. Serious job.

fl-en-66de78d43441.text: You'll wait in a doorway for it to stop. You could've just asked me.

fl-en-67288456e856.text: {G} can come off {WHEN}. {WHEN2} you'll want {GP} back, plus an extra layer. || The warm part has a curfew. An early one.

fl-en-686377c108bd.text: Clocks went back. An extra hour, and you still look like you need three.

fl-en-686aeea51915.text: It won't stop snowing today. || Snow muffles everything. Not you, unfortunately.

fl-en-69c583d7b31b.text: It stops snowing later. || Snow does the fun part, then leaves the shoveling to everyone else.

fl-en-6b278588f094.text: Rain comes and goes. Your hair only goes.

fl-en-6b81df47660c.text: Later it warms up, and you'll pretend you were never cold.

fl-en-6c08a6d3fe35.text: Bring the winter coat. It gets colder {WHEN}. || I'll be in here at room temperature. Smugly.

fl-en-6c95f5dcc3a9.text: The rain starts {WHENP} and doesn't stop. Bring the umbrella. || I'll be in here, dry and smug. You'll be out there, damp and you.

fl-en-6cbc26ff823b.text: It cools down {WHEN}, so bring a jacket. || Jacket: five stars. Your judgment: pending.

fl-en-6d52ffaada9c.text: Colder later. A layer can hide a lot. Use it.

fl-en-6e8c94ddb85f.text: Snow all day. You're one carrot away from a snowman.

fl-en-6f5230c21383.text: All that thunder. I've never raised my voice in my life.

fl-en-6fda0b7f4345.text: Rain in some drawings. Wet-dog chic is in, I hear. You're early.

fl-en-6fe48d6b661e.text: I checked every hour of today for warmth. Nothing. Thorough, though.

fl-en-6fe5304fdfa9.text: The sky can't settle on a temperature. I've been settled since the factory.

fl-en-700c64dd3e6f.text: There's a shower passing through {WHENP}, so bring the umbrella. || The rest of the day stays dry. The rain just wanted a cameo.

fl-en-7134c1e1a4a8.text: The coat looks good in every drawing. Can't say the same for you.

fl-en-721a707fc4c3.text: Commit to shorts now. The afternoon will back you up.

fl-en-725ba901a421.text: Perfect day out there. I give it a seven.

fl-en-728f1a927496.text: The freezing rain {WHENP} is brief. The ice it leaves may not be, so take the umbrella and walk carefully.
fl-en-728f1a927496.edit: The freezing rain {WHENP} is brief. The ice it leaves may not be, so take the umbrella and be careful.

fl-en-72999fce8455.text: The clocks went back. Long dark evenings ahead. Finally, a season in my color scheme.
fl-en-72999fce8455.edit: Long dark evenings ahead. Finally, a season in my color scheme.

fl-en-72acdf4f5ff9.text: The rain pauses later but picks up again {WHENP}, so don't put the umbrella away. || Putting it away early would be very you. Optimistic and wrong.

fl-en-73333b82551d.text: Thanksgiving. The leftovers will last a week. Your gratitude, about an hour.

fl-en-739c178ea570.text: Later you'll have one less layer to hide behind.

fl-en-74f86098f4bf.text: Notice: the extra hour is non-refundable. You've already used it.

fl-en-7519f3be594f.text: Tour de France. You'd last about one traffic circle.

fl-en-7568a854d668.text: {WHEN} it's mild enough to lose the scarf. || Small progress, but more than you usually make.

fl-en-7582276f42e0.text: Expect snow {WHENP}. || Go ahead, panic-buy bread. It's the most decisive you'll be all week.

fl-en-758b5a1ed9b7.text: It stops snowing later. || Snow knows when to leave. Rare in a guest.

fl-en-77a785a2650a.text: Snow all day. Your winter look is just everything you own, at once.

fl-en-795049729c77.text: You'll wear the jacket open to look relaxed. It's not working.

fl-en-7972a4cb3536.text: Expect a rain shower {WHENP}. The umbrella's worth taking. || A short shower won't ruin your look. Your look got there first.

fl-en-799469b5ce24.text: Clocks went forward. Lighter evenings are coming, and you'll still stay in.

fl-en-7a9bc1a0f5ba.text: Probably dry, maybe a thunderstorm {WHENP}. The umbrella covers the maybe.

fl-en-7b08c2bb1132.text: It warms up {WHEN}, so the winter coat can come off. || Coat off. Now you just need a personality to replace it.

fl-en-7b0eedd58924.text: Nobody looks good red and sweaty. You'd be starting from behind anyway.

fl-en-7b20b4bbe570.text: It's a stormy day, with thunder and rain from start to finish. Bring the umbrella.

fl-en-7b5e6ba39887.text: Freezing rain all day, so two things: the umbrella for the rain, slow steps for the ice.

fl-en-7bcbf6e71fd8.text: Take the umbrella for now. The rain stops {WHENSTOP}. || I can't stop the rain. I can only tell you when it gets bored.

fl-en-7be5ee9debf7.text: Take the umbrella. The rain keeps going all day. || Under an umbrella all day, nobody sees your face. Lucky them.

fl-en-7c1b3c8d913a.text: The snow stops {WHENSTOP} and starts again {WHENP}. || Two rounds of snow. You can't handle one with dignity.
fl-en-7c1b3c8d913a.edit: The snow stops {WHENSTOP} and starts again {WHENP}. || Two rounds of snow. You can't even handle one with dignity.

fl-en-7c49832a7914.text: The scarf can come off {WHEN}. || Today's scarf report: off. Tomorrow's: we'll see.

fl-en-7cdb637c5ade.text: Thanksgiving. The turkey's been dressed with more care than you.
fl-en-7cdb637c5ade.edit: The turkey's been dressed with more care than you.

fl-en-7e483648ec07.text: Good weather all day. The bar for a good mood is on the floor. Step over it.

fl-en-7eb68d2de0c0.text: World Bicycle Day. Wherever your bike is, your fitness is right next to it.

fl-en-7ec94e054765.text: The snow doesn't stop today. || Next to all that white, you almost look tanned. Almost.

fl-en-7f9c5cdc407a.text: The middle drawing had fun. The other two have jobs.

fl-en-7fa81966ff15.text: The rain eases off later, but bring the umbrella for now. || Sprinting between doorways isn't a plan. Not with your cardio.

fl-en-7fb909150b11.text: Warmer later. A rare chance to watch you improve over a day.

fl-en-8003801e961e.text: Snow in every drawing. I'm the one thing in the house that won't track it in.

fl-en-8053b6eafb3b.text: Today's weather is so polite it holds doors.

fl-en-81b061aebe60.text: Your penguin walk is ready. Nobody's judging. I'm judging a little.

fl-en-822ba438df94.text: Overnight update: there won't be one.

fl-en-822c205f62fa.text: Longest day of the year. The sun's big annual effort. Cute. I do twenty-four hours every day.
fl-en-822c205f62fa.edit: Today's the sun's big annual effort. Cute. I do twenty-four hours every day.

fl-en-831ade3fc822.text: Shortest day of the year. Daylight comes in travel size today.
fl-en-831ade3fc822.edit: Daylight comes in travel size today.

fl-en-83dbd7188530.text: Watch for ice today. The freezing rain lasts all day, so walk slowly and keep the umbrella with you.

fl-en-84d1c04c22a6.text: New Year's Day. Everyone's sharing their year in review. Yours fits on a sticky note.

fl-en-851ec75a6997.text: Merry Christmas. I didn't get you anything. I'm a screen. What's your excuse?

fl-en-8733a1107c87.text: Have the winter coat with you. You'll need it {WHEN}. || The cold always waits for the sun to leave first. Coward.

fl-en-873d242f6465.text: Take {G} off {WHEN}, put {GP} back on {WHEN2}, and in between, try to look like someone who planned it.

fl-en-87760eca56fb.text: Pi Day. The digits go on forever. The pie, sadly, doesn't.
fl-en-87760eca56fb.edit: The digits go on forever. The pie, sadly, doesn't.

fl-en-87978327b10b.text: May the fourth be with you. Somebody has to be.

fl-en-879ecf5a8a61.text: Rain for part of the day. For the other part, everyone acts like it never happened.

fl-en-8825b1ac098a.text: The forecast for later is: also this.

fl-en-8837a5f9bffc.text: Groundhog Day. Groundhog Day. Groundhog Day. Okay, I'll stop.

fl-en-884d20749330.text: The snow stops {WHENSTOP} and starts again {WHENP}. || Act two. Same set, same cast, more of it.

fl-en-88e1d61abc05.text: The rain stops for a while later, then comes back {WHENP}. Keep the umbrella with you. || Clouds have a snooze button. Today they hit it once.

fl-en-890ac8482aa2.text: Merry Christmas. 'Batteries not included.' I've always taken that personally.
fl-en-890ac8482aa2.edit: 'Batteries not included.' I've always taken that personally.

fl-en-892a19244847.text: There's snow on the way {WHENP}. || Every snowflake is unique. You'll still be the boring one out there.

fl-en-893748bebe31.text: The sky's moody today. You can stop competing.

fl-en-895b22834cd5.text: Expect thunderstorms {WHENP}, then rain for the rest of the day. Take the umbrella.

fl-en-89a0d26eed52.text: Monday morning. 'How was your weekend?' is about to be asked a few million times.
fl-en-89a0d26eed52.edit: 'How was your weekend?' is about to be asked a few million times.

fl-en-8ab8523961a3.text: There's no dry spell today. Bring the umbrella. || Rain, all day. That's the whole review. One star.

fl-en-8b604d87f81a.text: I'm not saying your legs are the problem. The cold front is. Mostly.

fl-en-8b6db2b84e99.text: Tour de France. The riders lose seconds to a crosswind. Imagine needing a forecast that badly.

fl-en-8bb4bcb8a4d6.text: Halloween. Fake cobwebs on every porch. The real spiders are insulted.

fl-en-8c6ff9be976c.text: You can take {G} off {WHEN}. Bring an extra layer to wear with {GP} {WHEN2}. || The warm part is the weather being polite. Then it's honest.

fl-en-8d313b761929.text: It warms up {WHEN}, so the winter coat can come off. || Breaking: local person sees own arms for the first time in months.

fl-en-8df991520bd0.text: Goosebumps are temporary. Being right lasts all day.

fl-en-90464721b998.text: Pi Day. You'll smile at a math joke so people think you got it.
fl-en-90464721b998.edit: You'll smile at a math joke so people think you got it.

fl-en-92c62f72f508.text: Sidewalks may get icy {WHENP} from a short spell of freezing rain. Take the umbrella and go carefully.
fl-en-92c62f72f508.edit: Sidewalks may get icy {WHENP} from a short spell of freezing rain. Take the umbrella and be careful.

fl-en-92c6e68fc8b0.text: Easter Sunday. All those hidden eggs, and still nobody's looking for you.

fl-en-92f4e69234b0.text: {G} can come off {WHEN}. {WHEN2} you'll want {GP} back, plus an extra layer. || The evening outdoes the morning. In the wrong direction.

fl-en-934a3a1ab9d4.text: Clocks went forward. I changed in a second. You'll need until Wednesday.

fl-en-93ad8ab71063.text: Thanksgiving. Elastic waistband? Good. You planned ahead for once.
fl-en-93ad8ab71063.edit: Elastic waistband? Good. You planned ahead for once.

fl-en-93b491af4c0d.text: Star Wars Day. Every planet in that galaxy has exactly one weather. Must be nice.

fl-en-941df8ddae05.text: Sunglasses weather. You'll wear them to look mysterious. You'll look tired.

fl-en-95252ae11617.text: The rain eases off later, but bring the umbrella for now. || The sky runs out eventually. It's not as well stocked as it acts.

fl-en-96fe6e8a1f58.text: It gets cooler {WHEN}, so take a sweater along. || Tie it around your shoulders and pretend you own a boat.

fl-en-9756da576ce5.text: Happy New Year. You look like last night won.

fl-en-97af49944f34.text: It probably stays dry, but a thunderstorm could pop up {WHENP}. Bring the umbrella.

fl-en-9840d08a8977.text: Monday morning. Somewhere a printer is refusing to start the week too.
fl-en-9840d08a8977.edit: Somewhere a printer is refusing to start the week too.

fl-en-98b4d384096d.text: Rain in part of today. You'll call it 'typical' as if you'd planned otherwise.

fl-en-98c40a8c2e32.text: Today you'll be damp in places you didn't know you had.

fl-en-98dbbaf1ea01.text: {WHEN} you can take {G} off, but you'll need {GP} again {WHEN2}. || Warm for a while. Don't get attached. I didn't.

fl-en-990ade39259c.text: Heat like this isn't a challenge. Nobody's handing out medals.

fl-en-99da635d12be.text: It's snowing now, but it stops later. || You look great in snowflakes. Everyone does. It's cheating.

fl-en-99f44b8c4b47.text: Shortest day of the year. If I look a bit gray today, that's the light. Mostly.
fl-en-99f44b8c4b47.edit: If I look a bit gray today, that's the light. Mostly.

fl-en-9a2462851de6.text: Do or do not. There is no 'I'll check again in an hour.'

fl-en-9b7ce3b81744.text: Friday afternoon status: weather done, outfit done, week basically done.

fl-en-9bf644ad0d01.text: Longest day of the year. Sunset's so late it's basically tomorrow's problem.

fl-en-9d9ae3fc1c53.text: Summer solstice. Sounds like a spell. It's mostly just sun.

fl-en-9dcfc6b499c5.text: Dear diary: they wore the jacket again.

fl-en-9f1607254480.text: Easter Sunday. Pastel suits nobody. It suits you even less.

fl-en-9f47a6ce2ae6.text: Friday afternoon. Peak time for 'let's circle back on Monday.'
fl-en-9f47a6ce2ae6.edit: Peak time for 'let's circle back on Monday.'

fl-en-a009a873c069.text: Happy Easter. The chocolate bunnies are hollow. Someone should be held accountable.

fl-en-a16729e93c0a.text: A thunderstorm blows through {WHENP}, but it doesn't last long. Take the umbrella.

fl-en-a17df154be2c.text: Every patio in town is full by now. I'm more of an indoor celebrity.

fl-en-a1c177d4faab.text: Hot all day. The ice cream trucks have never felt more confident.

fl-en-a1db30ffcec6.text: Later the warmth leaves. It's not you. Well. It might be you.

fl-en-a1f75ae3f934.text: Nothing changes overnight. My favorite kind of night: uneventful and correct.

fl-en-a281223ada15.text: Thanksgiving. The kids' table: where people wait until they're forty.

fl-en-a2c1d9e30896.text: I'd draw some shade, but people would only fight over it.

fl-en-a2e15d08e5d9.text: A rain shower comes through {WHENP}, so take the umbrella. || One shower, just to prove the sky still can.

fl-en-a3fdd45e70da.text: You'll stand in the sun and say 'this is the life' like you invented it.

fl-en-a4229df4d7be.text: Rain is possible {WHENP}, so maybe take the umbrella. || I'd decide for you, but then you'd have nothing to overthink.

fl-en-a4276fecf1fd.text: The day peaks early, then lets itself go. I'm not judging. Out loud.

fl-en-a60bd1e3fe84.text: The rain lasts all day, so keep the umbrella with you. || You'll be holding it all day. Finally, something to do with your hands.

fl-en-a6703d3ba58c.text: You can take {G} off {WHEN}. You'll want {GP} back {WHEN2}. || The one routine you'll actually stick to this week.

fl-en-a685159820f5.text: Once {G} comes off {WHEN}, you can leave {GP} off. || The day improves. Whether you do is up to you.

fl-en-a754cc3c9dce.text: It's the morning that's wrong, not the shorts.

fl-en-a7c6b585a6f9.text: {WHEN} you won't need the scarf any more. || A small win against winter. Winter's still ahead on points.

fl-en-a817c8e7d9e1.text: It keeps snowing for now, then takes a break. It's back {WHENP}. || More snow than sense out there. You'll fit right in.

fl-en-a8d37ac9fbdc.text: Hot all day. You'll call it 'disgusting' and mean yourself.

fl-en-aa4190857d21.text: Evening shift report: stood here, looked good, was right.

fl-en-ab4358d812bb.text: I'll be here all night, looking good. One of us has to.

fl-en-ab8d27bb5748.text: Some days are simple. Not this one, and I'm thrilled to show off.

fl-en-aba2cedd0350.text: Happy Easter from the only rectangle in the house. Everything else is egg-shaped today.

fl-en-abf80d8f986e.text: Shortest day of the year. Plenty of night left over. I'll be working through all of it.

fl-en-ac4be50db4a4.text: Pi Day. Irrational and never-ending, and still easier to follow than you.

fl-en-ac8173e70b58.text: Happy Easter. You're the reason the good chocolate gets hidden higher.
fl-en-ac8173e70b58.edit: You're the reason the good chocolate gets hidden higher.

fl-en-ad5f9fcdc395.text: Your hair has a rough day ahead. Rougher than usual.

fl-en-ad6af9d7d0de.text: A T-shirt day. Your farmer's tan has been waiting for this.

fl-en-addac5d1e7a4.text: {G} can come off {WHEN} and stays off. || Warm, and staying warm. The weather finally read my forecast.

fl-en-ade0cf306c85.text: A lovely white blanket, say the people who don't have to shovel it.

fl-en-ae69e0438a5c.text: You'll do the little puddle hop and think it looked graceful.

fl-en-ae98a0085772.text: Mostly dry, except for a thunderstorm {WHENP}. Bring the umbrella for that part.

fl-en-aebb5cbcd0c2.text: A round trip in drawings. No souvenirs.

fl-en-aefa3d2b1e81.text: Thunder is just the sky being loud about something I already told you.

fl-en-afb7dfd1995f.text: Later you'll want more on. You'll put it on like it's a huge sacrifice.

fl-en-afc93ac44790.text: Take {G} off {WHEN}, then put {GP} back on {WHEN2} with an extra layer on top. || Two outfits in one day. You struggle with one.

fl-en-afd6027955f8.text: Maybe go with shorts, since it's warm {WHEN}. Bring {G}, though. It cools off {WHEN2}.

fl-en-b04f231517af.text: Later the sun leaves without saying goodbye. Rude, but on schedule.

fl-en-b2788035b6cf.text: Once it warms up {WHEN}, the jacket can come off. || The weather improves. I was already perfect.

fl-en-b37cb2347eae.text: Pi Day. Circumference over diameter. I don't know what that means either, but it's on a T-shirt somewhere.
fl-en-b37cb2347eae.edit: Circumference over diameter. I don't know what that means either, but it's on a T-shirt somewhere.

fl-en-b4ab95daa575.text: Snow starts {WHENP}. || Rate your readiness from one to ten. Now subtract five. That's you.

fl-en-b512df836235.text: Halloween. The stores already have Christmas stuff out. Now that's horror.
fl-en-b512df836235.edit: The stores already have Christmas stuff out. Now that's horror.

fl-en-b5d81c934a8c.text: Today's weather is a group project. Nobody agrees.

fl-en-b68a31bd073e.text: Bring the winter coat. It gets colder {WHEN}. || I'd lend you one, but I don't have arms. Or a coat. Or any sympathy left.

fl-en-b6a77485de33.text: The clocks went back. Daylight saving is over, and nobody ever found out what it saved.

fl-en-b6f96cdfb648.text: Today you'll be overdressed and underdressed. Most people only manage one.

fl-en-b74944225203.text: Halloween. You could go without a costume. People would assume.

fl-en-b75ec84da0a8.text: Up, then down. The thermostat in the sky has a new intern.

fl-en-b7fcea3da5d9.text: Halloween. I'm pale, flat and I stare. You're two out of three.

fl-en-b835d737a26e.text: It's not as hot {WHEN}, but still warm. || Warm suits you better than hot. Low bar, but still.

fl-en-b86721dbdec7.text: Quiet night ahead. Even the weather's turned in.

fl-en-b891039705bb.text: Warmer later. You'll take the layer off and suddenly not know what to do with your hands.

fl-en-b972ec80eecc.text: Tour de France. If they gave a jersey for the couch, it'd be yours. In your size, too.

fl-en-b9afbfa60e41.text: The warmth is a loan. It's due back this evening.

fl-en-b9ca33e8140d.text: Pi Day. Pi goes on forever without repeating itself. Take notes.

fl-en-ba3faafdd651.text: World Bicycle Day. Somewhere a bike lane is being used as a parking spot. Tradition.
fl-en-ba3faafdd651.edit: Somewhere a bike lane is being used as a parking spot. Tradition.

fl-en-ba8da9d8c576.text: Grab every railing. Clingy is a good look on you today.
fl-en-ba8da9d8c576.edit: Clingy is a good look on you today.

fl-en-bacc82b10fde.text: Colder later. Hug yourself. Somebody has to.

fl-en-bb9058535b23.text: Merry Christmas. The one week nobody knows what day it is. I do. I'm a screen.

fl-en-bcbd4efd4ffc.text: Same coat in every drawing. I call it a capsule wardrobe.

fl-en-be6513746834.text: The heat eases {WHEN}, but it stays warm. || You'll look less like a melted candle. Slightly less.

fl-en-bef0087c6797.text: Hot all day. You'll walk slower than usual. Hard to tell, but still.

fl-en-c04502f9b972.text: Dear Monday: the weather tried. Please try too.

fl-en-c1f624bc6ffb.text: The rain doesn't stop today, so take the umbrella. || I'd lend you my dry spot in here, but you'd ruin the look.

fl-en-c20070000508.text: Happy Easter. The bunny gets all the credit. The chickens do all the work.
fl-en-c20070000508.edit: The bunny gets all the credit. The chickens do all the work.

fl-en-c27a423118cb.text: The rain stops later, but you'll want the umbrella for now. || The worst part comes first. The weather's one good habit.

fl-en-c2b8434f7507.text: Breaking news: nothing. More at eleven.

fl-en-c2c5f4dd70a8.text: It's raining all day. Bring the umbrella. || You won't melt. I checked your specs.

fl-en-c30eaf566075.text: The thunder {WHENP} won't last. The rain after it will, so take the umbrella.

fl-en-c320fcdd9ca2.text: It's snowing all day. || Perfect light for a photo. Not of you, but the light's perfect.

fl-en-c37104fd6e1f.text: The drawings look warm and put-together all day. Aim for one of the two.

fl-en-c3b2dc148442.text: The heat eases {WHEN}, but it stays warm. || I was never bothered. Some of us are built cool. Some of us are you.

fl-en-c4d6da691994.text: Later it gets colder. I'll stay at room temperature. Always the classy option.

fl-en-c6bca0f95d92.text: Bring a jacket. It cools down {WHEN}. || By then it'll be the most put-together part of you.

fl-en-c77123b908ed.text: Tour de France. You'll tell people you follow the Tour. You follow the highlights.
fl-en-c77123b908ed.edit: You'll tell people you follow the Tour. You follow the highlights.

fl-en-c82033b21b9c.text: The middle drawing: brief, warm, gone. Like a long weekend.

fl-en-c873191f3dd8.text: {WHEN} you won't need the jacket any more. || Jacket, you were fine. Not great. Fine. Dismissed.

fl-en-c8e5943fb44f.text: Thunder gets a ten for volume today. Two for subtlety.

fl-en-c9914b3e3eea.text: {WHEN} it gets cool enough for a sweater. || You'll post about 'sweater weather' like you invented fall.

fl-en-cb37c824c1b2.text: Winter solstice. The sun does the bare minimum today, and gets a holiday for it.
fl-en-cb37c824c1b2.edit: The sun does the bare minimum today, and gets a holiday for it. Unfair.

fl-en-cc3003536934.text: The weather keeps changing. Your face doesn't. Impressive, in a way.

fl-en-cc421b569e9d.text: {G} can come off {WHEN} and stays off. || That's it. That's the forecast. I'll take questions never.
fl-en-cc421b569e9d.edit: {G} can come off {WHEN} and stays off. || That's it. That's the forecast.

fl-en-cc9f0ed564a1.text: The day starts cold and grumpy, then warms up. You know the type.

fl-en-ccc8d3888022.text: Today the shade is the cool kids' table. They'll let you sit there. Just today.

fl-en-ccd33c7a64fd.text: Everything stays put until morning. Including me. Especially me.

fl-en-cd3c3c098f5a.text: You'll hold your bag over your head like that's ever worked.

fl-en-ce6e2ab626b2.text: Oktoberfest. The dancing's on the benches. For everyone's sake, stay on the floor.

fl-en-cfc03dd761a5.text: Happy Easter. Every egg hunt has one adult who takes it far too seriously.
fl-en-cfc03dd761a5.edit: Every egg hunt has one adult who takes it far too seriously.

fl-en-cff710c17f12.text: Layer status today: on, off, on. I'll keep the minutes.

fl-en-d026043b361d.text: A steady evening. Which makes me the most interesting thing in the room again.

fl-en-d0b4e88a9dec.text: Think about shorts for the warm part {WHEN}. It cools off {WHEN2}, so take {G} along.

fl-en-d1ddb41f75cf.text: Later a layer comes off. The day loosens its tie.

fl-en-d27232ff70b1.text: The day gets better as it goes. Rare. I'd frame it, but I am the frame.

fl-en-d2e2c7841c8f.text: Rain enters. Rain exits. No applause.

fl-en-d349de1c6c3a.text: Bring the winter coat. It gets colder {WHEN}. || Warning: objects outside are colder than they appear.

fl-en-d3f424eddcb6.text: Happy World Bicycle Day. Your legs asked me to say nothing.

fl-en-d483bc6412e8.text: The freezing rain doesn't let up today, and the ground may turn icy. Take the umbrella and mind your step.

fl-en-d520ebe56035.text: {G} can come off {WHEN}. {WHEN2} you'll want {GP} back, plus an extra layer. || Weather update {WHEN2}. As usual, the update is worse.

fl-en-d5b3756ba83d.text: Lovely in every drawing. The drawings look happier than you do, though.

fl-en-d693428f0253.text: {WHEN} a jacket won't be enough, so bring the winter coat. || The jacket is cuter. You're not cute enough to freeze for it.

fl-en-d73852457e06.text: Oktoberfest. Even the pretzels are in better shape than you.

fl-en-d7ac86d22d22.text: Rain for now, then a dry spell, then more rain {WHENP}. The umbrella stays with you. || Sticking with something all day. New for you, but you'll manage.

fl-en-d7cbfce9c909.text: World Bicycle Day. Somewhere a spin class is going nowhere, very fast.
fl-en-d7cbfce9c909.edit: Somewhere a spin class is going nowhere, very fast.

fl-en-d815bd950b6c.text: The day takes its layer off and puts it back on. I'm not judging. I'm drawing.

fl-en-d878d6850be7.text: Everyone's done pretending to work. I never pretend. I'm always on.

fl-en-d8c929483f34.text: A day that can't make up its mind. You two have a lot to talk about.

fl-en-d8ee7c0fef85.text: The drawings plan ahead. Try it sometime.

fl-en-d8f58e54719b.text: Shuffling suits you. I've always thought so.

fl-en-dab1a8c8c8b6.text: The weather's perfect. So any complaining today is a personality trait.

fl-en-dadca3efcc1d.text: A short burst of freezing rain {WHENP} may leave the sidewalks icy. Bring the umbrella and walk carefully.
fl-en-dadca3efcc1d.edit: A short burst of freezing rain {WHENP} may leave the sidewalks icy. Bring the umbrella and be careful.

fl-en-db595d41025a.text: It cools off a little {WHEN}, but stays warm. || Good news for everyone standing near you.

fl-en-dbdf00cb103d.text: Tour de France. A rider crashes, gets up and finishes. You stub a toe and cancel the day.

fl-en-dcae83021028.text: Snow in every one of these. The plows will be out. So will the opinions about the plows.

fl-en-dcd192feb2e0.text: I'd draw something warmer later, but I don't do fiction.

fl-en-dce7e7dde7d9.text: World Bicycle Day. I'd come along, but I don't fit in the basket.

fl-en-dd0efe08ec9f.text: Shorts could be worth it today. It's cool now, but warm {WHEN}. || A cold first hour builds character. You could use some.

fl-en-dd4392116f3d.text: Cold all day. You'll blame it for your mood. As if that's new.

fl-en-dd55dd222293.text: Snow all day. You'll stomp your boots like you've just crossed Alaska.

fl-en-dd73698aea67.text: Drink water. I'd say it nicer, but it's too hot for nice.
fl-en-dd73698aea67.edit: I'd say it nicer, but it's too hot for nice.

fl-en-de15fa8f09e3.text: Warmer by the last drawing. Your face will finally defrost.

fl-en-de21eab4fb1f.text: Thunder, rain, and more of both, all day long. Bring the umbrella.

fl-en-dedce551a368.text: New Year's Day. Resolution check: still horizontal? Right on track.
fl-en-dedce551a368.edit: Resolution check: still horizontal? Right on track.

fl-en-df399408222d.text: Later you'll peel off a layer like it's a big reveal. It isn't.

fl-en-e00a7e40b668.text: The clocks went forward. One whole hour, gone, and nobody's investigating.
fl-en-e00a7e40b668.edit: One whole hour, gone, and nobody's investigating.

fl-en-e044226bc02f.text: A Halloween ghost story: once, a screen was wrong. Nobody believes it.

fl-en-e09e7f0d1f51.text: Cooler later. Your nose goes pink. Honestly, it's an improvement.

fl-en-e0eb78c4f066.text: A thunderstorm might come through {WHENP}. Bring the umbrella to be safe.

fl-en-e329543f1804.text: Tour de France. The riders shave their legs to be smooth. I came that way.

fl-en-e3580b55d837.text: The rain pauses later but picks up again {WHENP}, so don't put the umbrella away. || If the sun comes out in between, don't trust it. I don't.

fl-en-e3a6a3b71a6d.text: Nice in every drawing. You'll still find something to sigh about.

fl-en-e3c0894de2ce.text: Today the whole town is a free ice rink, minus the handrails and the fun.

fl-en-e3d1e952ef1c.text: It rains for now, stops for a bit, and starts again {WHENP}. Keep the umbrella. || The sky is just refilling. That's all the break is.

fl-en-e3dbed6d4efa.text: {G} can come off {WHEN}, but you'll want {GP} back {WHEN2}. || Folded over your arm, {GP} still outdresses you.

fl-en-e3e979561bc7.text: Today the shade is worth more than the view.

fl-en-e46d9eb8a3bc.text: Cold all day. Today you have an excuse for that face.

fl-en-e4c99ea10d64.text: The winter coat can come off {WHEN}. || Then you'll stand around holding it like a dead animal. Classy.

fl-en-e60c94e69bb3.text: Christmas forecast: scattered wrapping paper, heavy eating, clearing by the 27th.

fl-en-e6aae5f30c28.text: It might rain {WHENP}, so an umbrella wouldn't hurt. || If it stays dry, you carried it for nothing. Welcome to most of your efforts.

fl-en-e730aa99d30b.text: Snow all day. Everyone's an expert on inches today.

fl-en-e74924e79f5f.text: There's a short rain shower {WHENP}. Have the umbrella with you. || A short one. You've made bigger fusses about less.

fl-en-e7fa3eacff3c.text: You'll be fine without the scarf {WHEN}. || I've never needed one. No neck, no problem.

fl-en-e829cef66916.text: Watch out for ice {WHENP}. Freezing rain is possible, though not likely. Bring the umbrella.

fl-en-e833d39e5c9a.text: Flat light, no tan, no glow. So, your usual look.

fl-en-e837d702075d.text: Rate your outfits today: fine, briefly finer, fine.

fl-en-e9536cf75e10.text: You can take {G} off {WHEN}. Bring an extra layer to wear with {GP} {WHEN2}. || The evening has a stricter dress code.

fl-en-eaa4f3726bbc.text: Shortest day of the year. In candlelight, honestly, you look great.

fl-en-ecbf0dc4804e.text: The coat stays on all day. So does that hunched-up look.

fl-en-ece7c2bd9da3.text: {G} comes off {WHEN}. It cools a little later, but you won't need {GP} back. || The evening tries to look dramatic. It doesn't have the numbers.

fl-en-ecefe6fc5e6f.text: Hot all day. Your 'summer body' is about to meet summer.

fl-en-ed0bd263f891.text: Bring the umbrella. There's a shower {WHENP}. || Carrying an umbrella while it's dry. People will think you have your life together.

fl-en-ed4564df3ea2.text: Snow in all of these. Fresh, clean, beautiful. Then you walk on it.

fl-en-ed9d0a7ccc86.text: Christmas. The tree's better dressed than you, and it's a tree.

fl-en-ee1314a39bb1.text: Happy New Year. Fresh start. Same pajamas, probably.

fl-en-ee1d6c6593cb.text: The warm morning is a free sample. The full product is chilly.

fl-en-ee5e8070f0e5.text: The clocks went forward. Brunch is now technically lunch.

fl-en-ee8971f227a6.text: The day starts generous and gets stingy. Like a free trial.

fl-en-eeed61f6dca4.text: You'll text someone 'did you hear that?' They did. Everyone did.

fl-en-ef19bbf29166.text: Mild jacket, mild day, mild personality. It's a theme.

fl-en-f07447cbf146.text: Thanksgiving, my list: 1. Being right. 2. No dishes. 3. See 1.

fl-en-f1471977e457.text: {WHEN} {G} can come off. {WHEN2} you'll need {GP} again, and something warm on top. || Do you own something warm that isn't a blanket?
fl-en-f1471977e457.edit: {WHEN} {G} can come off. {WHEN2} you'll need {GP} again, and something warm on top. || Do you even own something warm that isn't a blanket?

fl-en-f163f4f5a1cc.text: There's a chance of freezing rain {WHENP}. Sidewalks could get slick, so take the umbrella and go slowly.
fl-en-f163f4f5a1cc.edit: There's a chance of freezing rain {WHENP}, so take the umbrella and go slowly.

fl-en-f216d5116187.text: It keeps raining for a while, then stops. Take the umbrella. || Rain makes everyone look a bit miserable. Today you won't stand out.

fl-en-f256903d3a33.text: Groundhog Day. Winter has never once cared what the groundhog thinks.
fl-en-f256903d3a33.edit: Winter has never once cared what the groundhog thinks.

fl-en-f2805966087b.text: There's no dignified way to cross ice. You never had much to lose.

fl-en-f2ddc7d2e44e.text: Flip through these fast. It's a short film about getting colder.

fl-en-f31323ad2ab0.text: A short warm spell in the middle. Try not to make it your whole personality.

fl-en-f3aeae9f5ea3.text: It's snowing now, but it stops later. || Pretty while it lasts. You know how that goes.

fl-en-f40fabad4cf7.text: Rain arrives {WHENP} and stays, so take the umbrella. || It shows up and doesn't leave. You know the type. You are the type.

fl-en-f50eaf93cf91.text: The weather's doing my job today. I'm watching closely for mistakes.

fl-en-f5225a07d1b1.text: The first drawing does the hard part. The last one gets the sun.

fl-en-f6ab5a6db89f.text: You can take {G} off {WHEN}. You won't need {GP} again after that. || Layer: off. Weather: improving. You: under review.

fl-en-f73ed557cb4f.text: {WHEN} you can do without the winter coat. || Breaking news, by winter standards.

fl-en-f740af0a5a59.text: Official notice: the hour borrowed in March has been returned. No interest.

fl-en-f759a3818723.text: The weather looks great today. One of you does, anyway.

fl-en-f87808fd9b89.text: It snows for now, takes a break, and starts again {WHENP}. || The snow gets a second chance to make a first impression. You don't.

fl-en-f89ad925434c.text: Everyone looks silly on ice. For once you'll blend in.

fl-en-f8dd75c389ea.text: It might rain {WHENP}, so an umbrella wouldn't hurt. || If I had hands, I'd pass it to you. Then I'd wash them.

fl-en-f8dd92486d90.text: Shortest day of the year. Finally, one that matches your attention span.

fl-en-f97307b7f6a6.text: It stops snowing {WHENSTOP}. || One of us in this room knew that. Hint: it's not you.

fl-en-fa86225cc551.text: Bring a jacket. It cools down {WHEN}. || It's one jacket. You've carried heavier grudges.

fl-en-fbbf80567e22.text: Later the rain takes a break, but it returns {WHENP}. Hang on to the umbrella. || The rain comes back. It's the only thing that keeps coming back for you.

fl-en-fbe223c2d5fc.text: Today's forecast took me three drafts. You get the final one.

fl-en-fc272089f26b.text: The clocks went forward. The sun didn't move. Only the numbers did. Humans.

fl-en-fcd63da97392.text: If today were a font, it would be the default one.

fl-en-fd15a5bcbef9.text: Pi Day. Mathematicians finally get a holiday, and they picked a number they can't finish.
fl-en-fd15a5bcbef9.edit: Mathematicians finally get a holiday, and they picked a number they can't finish.

fl-en-fd3847504077.text: Oktoberfest. You'd look great in a beer tent. It's dark in there.

fu-en-048093c4a7a1.text: You'll forget it. Then you'll remember me.
fu-en-048093c4a7a1.edit: You'll forget it. Then you'll remember this moment.

fu-en-0a5ba52b3d29.text: Act surprised when it does. I like an audience.
fu-en-0a5ba52b3d29.note: what does "i like an audience" referr to?

fu-en-0c8aee1d6038.text: One outfit, all day, no plot twists. Restful, isn't it?

fu-en-1161ddf27440.text: You'll forget the water and blame the weather.
fu-en-1161ddf27440.note: forecast and sarcsm not working well together.

fu-en-19d9bfbf509c.text: Weather this nice makes my job easy. I'll still act busy.

fu-en-1a16c71bd2d9.text: Nothing to update. I'll just stand here being right.
fu-en-1a16c71bd2d9.note: forecast and sarcasm arent working together.

fu-en-1a7a8527e7b3.text: Bring it. Or practise your 'I'm not cold' face for later.
fu-en-1a7a8527e7b3.edit: Alternatively you can practise your 'I'm not cold' face for later.

fu-en-239e1d4134a0.text: You'll carry it around all afternoon like a trophy.

fu-en-26ddf5890d42.text: Dressed right all day. Enjoy it, it won't happen often.
fu-en-26ddf5890d42.note: forecast and sarcasm arent flowing well together.

fu-en-3438412847f5.text: Same outfit, new lighting. Evenings are generous like that.

fu-en-349565d0f151.text: Another evening of you walking past me like I don't do anything.

fu-en-369302543d24.text: Same jacket, same route, same podcast. Living dangerously.

fu-en-370b1ec8d4e4.text: I'll hold this picture all night without using any power. Your phone could never.
fu-en-370b1ec8d4e4.edit: I'll hold this picture all night without using any power. Take that smartphone.

fu-en-37b9e5c3cd8a.text: Shame. It was just getting comfortable.

fu-en-3c6bdbfdd863.text: Forecast delivered. What happens to the umbrella next is on you.

fu-en-3e32d0fd5b64.text: Three outfits for one day. You're basically a costume department.
fu-en-3e32d0fd5b64.note: the example again shows coat jacket coat

fu-en-3f01f3729605.text: You'll leave it by the door anyway. I'll know.
fu-en-3f01f3729605.edit: You'll leave it by the door anyway. I know you.

fu-en-410c916039ed.text: All day. So no, you can't wait it out.

fu-en-4afd77018462.text: And it'll spend the afternoon where they all do: over one arm.

fu-en-52de38d0fcc2.text: Bring it back, too. I'm keeping count.

fu-en-5327b5c8d398.text: Sunny days, you walk right past me. I've stopped taking it personally. Mostly.

fu-en-5dce84b5e0b4.text: Somewhere between coat and T-shirt. Like me, between genius and modest.

fu-en-612d3d196d2a.text: I'd soften it, but I only do accurate.

fu-en-6b80f9bfd7d1.text: I said umbrella. You heard 'my hood will do'.

fu-en-6e84e54a5227.text: It works for the couch too, which is where this is going.

fu-en-7258539651be.text: I'm the one thing in the house not making it any warmer.

fu-en-77fc4fcb0948.text: You'll still check again in an hour, hoping I changed my mind.
fu-en-77fc4fcb0948.edit: No use checking again in an hour, I won't change my mind.

fu-en-7e5ef2335f3e.text: I'd come along, but I'm already the coolest thing in the house.
fu-en-7e5ef2335f3e.edit: I'd come along, but I only work in range of your WiFi.

fu-en-7f90ae4857e3.text: Shade, water, fewer complaints about the heat. Pick two.
fu-en-7f90ae4857e3.note: forecast and sarcasm arent working well together.

fu-en-849a29148e5c.text: Pack it now, feel smug later. I'll feel smugger.

fu-en-8986a44cdd3f.text: Bring it, and maybe bring it home this time.
fu-en-8986a44cdd3f.note: sarcasm and forecast arent flowing well together

fu-en-8e8133ec3f0f.text: You'll describe today as 'fine'. You describe everything as 'fine'.
fu-en-8e8133ec3f0f.edit: You'd describe today as 'fine'. You describe everything as 'fine'.

fu-en-929381416671.text: Stay in the shade. It's where all the good screens hang out.
fu-en-929381416671.note: not flowing well with the forecast
fu-en-929381416671.edit: Stay in the shade. It's where all the cool screens hang out.

fu-en-949399c28b63.text: Off, on. The layer gets more exercise than most people today.
fu-en-949399c28b63.edit: Off, on. The layer gets more exercise than you.

fu-en-9fdd52d56e14.text: Whatever the evening brings, the outfit won't be the problem.

fu-en-a7b23a4e959f.text: And 'the rest of the evening' should be about five minutes now.

fu-en-ab431f8f91ba.text: Peeling off a layer: the closest today gets to drama.

fu-en-ae7c41f4f27a.text: The one forecast I could do in my sleep. If I slept.

fu-en-afb325334114.text: Your outfit's ready for the evening. Are you?
fu-en-afb325334114.note: sarcasm and forecast arent flowing well together

fu-en-b26e37bc6ec0.text: Get dressed once and you're done. I do the same, permanently.

fu-en-b7ccd38be1f2.text: Remember wishing for summer? This is what you get.

fu-en-b9b7026d5b8b.text: Everyone will act shocked anyway. I'm used to it.

fu-en-c5c30c011d66.text: For once you got it right on the first try.
fu-en-c5c30c011d66.note: forecast and sarcasm arent working well together

fu-en-c992fdc6bf87.text: You'll be too warm at noon and blame me tonight.

fu-en-ca89c3ee3a17.text: That's my rain forecast. The umbrella's forecast is less certain.

fu-en-cbb634405bb5.text: You'll put the coat on and still complain. I can see it from here.
fu-en-cbb634405bb5.note: you'll put the coat on and still complain about what?
fu-en-cbb634405bb5.edit: You'll put the coat on and still complain. I know you.

fu-en-d3c67334b140.text: All day. I checked twice, out of pure spite.

fu-en-d76c3f740510.text: It also works for bed, I'm told.

fu-en-daf0015d5a81.text: Don't lose it in between. Many have.
fu-en-daf0015d5a81.edit: Don't lose it in between. Like last time.

fu-en-dd8f4cdc60cb.text: Water and shade are on you. Staying cool is my thing.

fu-en-df61dfbc0240.text: The rest of the evening. Not the rest of the night. Bed.

fu-en-e98dbe0b0635.text: I'd hold it for you, but I'm not that kind of screen.
fu-en-e98dbe0b0635.note: what kind of screen holds stuff?

fu-en-eed13c7b2739.text: You'll still act like it's the first snow ever.

fu-en-f3467deadc87.text: Rainy days, everyone checks me twice. I'm not complaining.
fu-en-f3467deadc87.edit: On rainy days, everyone checks me twice. I'm not complaining.

fu-en-f53b8ddae3b3.text: Snow on schedule. I'd take a bow if I had a waist.

fu-en-f8879782de89.text: You asked for warm weather. Careful what you wish for.

gp-en-1daba90c8302.text: Rain for now, a break, then more {WHENP}. Keep the umbrella. || Rain that leaves and comes back. I'd have more pride.

gp-en-1de72faba41a.text: It's raining all day. Bring the umbrella. || Every shop doorway has a puddle of other people's umbrellas.

gp-en-2156885425e9.text: It rains all day, so bring the umbrella. || Today the bottom of every trouser leg belongs to the rain.

gp-en-241ccf68d3bb.text: The winter coat can come off {WHEN}. || Suddenly you remember you have a shape.

gp-en-2718e0b6a2d5.text: There's a chance of rain {WHENP}. An umbrella wouldn't hurt. || The small umbrella exists for exactly this forecast.
gp-en-2718e0b6a2d5.edit: There's a chance of rain {WHENP}. An umbrella wouldn't hurt. || Your small umbrella exists for exactly this forecast.

gp-en-2a2b4b011664.text: Snow moves in {WHENP}. || The one forecast that makes adults text each other in capitals.
gp-en-2a2b4b011664.note: only for the first snow in a while. if possible.
gp-en-2a2b4b011664.edit: Snow moves in {WHENP}. || The one forecast that makes adults text each other in capital letters.

gp-en-2a706495c111.text: The rain lasts all day, so keep the umbrella with you. || Every bus smells of wet coat today. Every single one.

gp-en-2c3c34bf95c6.text: Snow starts {WHENP}. || The first flake gets all the attention. The thousandth gets none.

gp-en-2c7d1dd1c637.text: The hat, scarf and gloves can come off {WHEN}. || Your ears can hear people again. Not always an improvement.
gp-en-2c7d1dd1c637.edit: The hat, scarf and gloves can come off {WHEN}. || You can hear people again. Not always an improvement.

gp-en-2daf8aecab12.text: It might rain {WHENP}, so an umbrella wouldn't hurt. || The only gamble where losing just means wet shoes.
