po-en-54794599b332.text: A thunderstorm is possible {WHENP}. If it comes, wait it out indoors.

po-en-58a5bde5e095.text: Freezing rain sets in {WHENP} and stays, so roads and pavements may be icy. Walk carefully.

po-en-60dd39409799.text: No showing off on the ice today. Yes, you were going to.

po-en-63af1238db42.text: Thunder for now, so stay indoors if you can. The storm clears {WHENSTOP}.

po-en-67bea377b068.text: You're set for the whole day.

po-en-728941f49470.text: The rain stops {WHENSTOP}, then a thunderstorm arrives {WHENP}. Be indoors for that one if you can.

po-en-762c3ebe8244.text: It's warm enough for shorts {WHEN}. Think about shorts, with {G} on top for now.
po-en-762c3ebe8244.edit: It's warm enough for shorts {WHEN}. Think about it, with {G} on top for now.

po-en-855a27f6fb4e.text: If the power goes out, I'll still be here, showing this.

po-en-86f63eddb8c5.text: A thunderstorm comes {WHENP}, after a dry spell. Try to be indoors for that one.
po-en-86f63eddb8c5.edit: A thunderstorm comes {WHENP}, after a short dry spell. Try to be indoors for that one.

po-en-8759ae6a0bb5.text: You'll announce 'it's actually warm' to people who are also outside.

po-en-875dfb347985.text: You'll text 'running late'. Please don't actually run.

po-en-88c0238a4cae.text: You'll feel overdressed at first. Then very well informed.

po-en-8d394c77819f.text: The freezing rain stops {WHENSTOP} and returns {WHENP}. Pavements may be icy all day, so walk carefully.

po-en-92a8cf140e6c.text: The snow stops {WHENSTOP} and starts again {WHENP}.

po-en-987280bd495b.text: {WHEN} it's coat weather. Long pants and a warm coat are worth thinking about.

po-en-9bfd91ee29f4.text: Cold weather is coming {WHEN}, so long pants and a warm coat might be wise.

po-en-ad79aa3b5012.text: You'll keep it closed through the whole shower. 'It's only spitting.'

po-en-afd004ced2d6.text: Shorts might work today: warm {WHEN}, cooler {WHEN2}. Keep {G} with you either way.

po-en-b4c2e6c8b1e4.text: You'll call it your good jacket. It's your only jacket.
po-en-b4c2e6c8b1e4.edit: You call this your good jacket. It's your only jacket.

po-en-b74edc529407.text: The jacket pocket pat-down: keys, phone, wallet. Then again, slower.

po-en-c0d08e4486ae.text: The thunderstorm passes {WHENSTOP}. Until it does, stay inside if you can.

po-en-c29ebe82aa25.text: The leftovers in your fridge, less so.

po-en-c6b51f945b7c.text: You'll go out just to hear it crunch. Admit it.

po-en-c960fa1164e4.text: The rain stops {WHENSTOP} and comes back {WHENP}. Keep the umbrella with you.

po-en-e1a35cd89dfc.text: The coolest spot in the house is the floor. I won't tell anyone.

po-en-e23aa803837d.text: Small steps today. I'm the expert: I haven't taken one in years.
po-en-e23aa803837d.edit: Small steps today. Trust me, even though I haven't taken steps in years.

po-en-e557cb214812.text: You'll probably be in joggers within the hour anyway.

po-en-eb5d1e58dbb5.text: The freezing rain stops {WHENSTOP}. Roads and pavements may stay icy after that, so walk carefully.
po-en-eb5d1e58dbb5.edit: The freezing rain stops {WHENSTOP}. Roads and pavements may stay icy, so walk carefully.

po-en-ec7f3217e1e5.text: Watch for ice. The freezing rain stops {WHENSTOP}, but pavements may stay icy.
po-en-ec7f3217e1e5.edit: The freezing rain stops {WHENSTOP}, but pavements may stay icy.

po-en-f9d8883b7397.text: You'll scroll in bed for an hour and call it winding down.

po-en-fa8c58cda69b.text: {WHEN} it's warm enough for shorts, so think about wearing them now.

rn-en-0019850fa46c.text: It rains for now, stops for a bit, and starts again {WHENP}. Keep the umbrella. || The rain gets a break. The umbrella doesn't.

rn-en-03fa7162c7c0.text: The rain is here for now but stops later, so bring the umbrella. || It stops later. Your hair won't recover that fast.

rn-en-04fec0000d23.text: {WHEN} it gets cold enough for a hat, scarf and gloves. || Cold enough. I measured. Well, a satellite did.
rn-en-04fec0000d23.edit: {WHEN} it gets cold enough for a hat, scarf and gloves. || I measured. Well, a satellite did.

rn-en-05d36a06d944.text: The rain stops later, but you'll want the umbrella for now. || Then you'll have a wet umbrella and nowhere to put it.

rn-en-08061f2eabbd.text: Rain arrives {WHENP} and stays, so take the umbrella. || Tonight I'm the only thing in here that won't need drying.

rn-en-09c67729f8ca.text: It starts snowing {WHENP}. || You'll check out of the window every ten minutes. I'll be over here, correct.

rn-en-0c8c8ade9531.text: The heat eases {WHEN}, but it stays warm. || It eases. Your mood might too. No promises.
rn-en-0c8c8ade9531.edit: The heat eases {WHEN}, but it stays warm. || Your mood might ease too. No promises.

rn-en-0f10ad860832.text: Take {G} off {WHEN}, then put {GP} back on {WHEN2} with an extra layer on top. || On top, not instead. I know you.

rn-en-0f7ab014a5ff.text: Snow moves in {WHENP}. || Moves in. Like it's paying rent.

rn-en-1272183590e6.text: Have the winter coat with you. You'll need it {WHEN}. || With you. Not on the hook, looking at you.

rn-en-1395bf9d78a6.text: Shorts could be worth it today. It's cool now, but warm {WHEN}. || Could. Or go long and complain all afternoon. Your call.

rn-en-15873b9a5c5d.text: It's snowing now, but it stops later. || So the pretty part has a deadline.

rn-en-16aa5caa7515.text: It could rain {WHENP}. Take the umbrella to be safe. || It's a small chance. Small chances have soaked better people.

rn-en-1a663c113fbc.text: The snow stops {WHENSTOP} and starts again {WHENP}. || Two snowfalls in one day. I'll take the credit for both.

rn-en-1c57062f3b44.text: There's no dry spell today. Bring the umbrella. || Except in here. I'm the dry spell.

rn-en-23e6fa3717f3.text: {G} can come off {WHEN} and stays off. || Stays off. I'm not changing my mind about this one.
rn-en-23e6fa3717f3.edit: {G} can come off {WHEN} and stays off. || I'm not changing my mind about this one.

rn-en-268194b9728b.text: It rains all day, so bring the umbrella. || The washing stays in today. So do I, but that's normal.

rn-en-26b41df3a13b.text: There's no break in the snow today. || Not even for you.

rn-en-296e26951a01.text: There's a shower passing through {WHENP}, so bring the umbrella. || It passes through. You'll take it personally.

rn-en-2c5feef45f75.text: It's snowing all day. || I've never been out in it. I hear it's overrated after the first hour.
rn-en-2c5feef45f75.edit: It's snowing all day. || I've never been out in it. I hear it's overrated.

rn-en-314b5ca3abb4.text: The rain lasts all day, so keep the umbrella with you. || All day means all day. Not 'until I'm bored of carrying it'.

rn-en-3342070e1dd0.text: Rain is possible {WHENP}, so maybe take the umbrella. || Maybe. If you don't, it definitely will.

rn-en-3423b2681f97.text: The hat, scarf and gloves can come off {WHEN}. || All at once is a lot of excitement. Pace yourself.

rn-en-34e6d7a6ff1e.text: {WHENP} it starts to snow. || Before that, it's just cold. After, it's cold and pretty.

rn-en-35d4151c9e4e.text: It keeps snowing for now, then takes a break. It's back {WHENP}. || It takes one break. You'll take three.

rn-en-37d4822a43cf.text: The snow stops later. || That's when the wet socks start.

rn-en-39f2366469b6.text: Take the umbrella for now. The rain stops {WHENSTOP}. || On time, if I have anything to do with it. I don't, but still.

rn-en-40edf8e4b21c.text: It snows all day. || All day. The novelty lasts about an hour.
rn-en-40edf8e4b21c.edit: It snows all day. || The novelty lasts about an hour.

rn-en-44a5d92fc0e1.text: Snow moves in {WHENP}. || Finally, a reason to cancel the plans you were dreading.

rn-en-44cbd4e7cdc2.text: {WHENP} the rain sets in for good. Bring the umbrella. || 'For good' meaning today. I don't do forever.

rn-en-45be25b3e769.text: It rains all day, so bring the umbrella. || All day. So no, waiting ten minutes won't help.

rn-en-46bc020ffea9.text: The rain doesn't stop today, so take the umbrella. || Neither will your complaining. At least the rain has an excuse.

rn-en-4713b851d071.text: A shower comes through {WHENP}, so take the umbrella. || It's a short one. Long enough to ruin your hair, though.

rn-en-499b65e195e4.text: The snow stops {WHENSTOP} and starts again {WHENP}. || The break is just long enough to start believing it's over.

rn-en-4b81c8670010.text: Pack the umbrella. Rain sets in {WHENP} and doesn't let up. || It doesn't let up. I don't either. We get on well.

rn-en-4c88311cc5a6.text: The rain starts {WHENP} and doesn't stop. Bring the umbrella. || It has more stamina than you. Most things do.

rn-en-4dec290987ee.text: {WHEN} you can do without the winter coat. || You can. Whether you will is your business.

rn-en-4fa65f9ea39e.text: It's cool now, but {WHEN} it's warm enough for shorts. || Maybe shorts. Your legs could use the daylight, frankly.
rn-en-4fa65f9ea39e.edit: It's cool now, but {WHEN} it's warm enough for shorts. || Your legs could use the daylight, frankly.

rn-en-51cd73aa3ecd.text: Bring the umbrella. There's a shower {WHENP}. || Yes, the folding one that won't fold. That one.

rn-en-590397774eeb.text: There's a short shower {WHENP}. Have the umbrella with you. || With you means in your hand. Not in the other bag.

rn-en-5b0f43a13bc6.text: The rain stops {WHENSTOP}, but you'll want the umbrella before that. || I'll let you know when. Well, I just did.

rn-en-5ff4f2b716a6.text: It's a bit cool for shorts now, but {WHEN} you'll be glad of them. || Chilly now, glad later. Like most good decisions.

rn-en-62673bb7d17c.text: {WHEN} {G} can come off. {WHEN2} you'll need {GP} again, and something warm on top. || And no, a hot drink isn't a layer.
rn-en-62673bb7d17c.edit: {WHEN} {G} can come off. {WHEN2} you'll need {GP} again, and something warm on top. || And no, a hot drink isn't an extra layer.

rn-en-62a54b5437e5.text: {WHEN} it gets cold enough for the winter coat. || Cold enough for you to admit it, even.

rn-en-68461891e4f9.text: You can take {G} off {WHEN}. Bring an extra layer to wear with {GP} {WHEN2}. || The day ends colder. Like my jokes.

rn-en-68806d351610.text: Take a bottle of water. The heat arrives {WHEN}. || A full one. Not the one with a sip left in it since Tuesday.

rn-en-68f0d281bd03.text: Rain arrives {WHENP} and stays, so take the umbrella. || Staying in was your plan anyway. Now you have a reason.

rn-en-6a159831df94.text: You can take {G} off {WHEN}. Even later on, you won't need {GP}. || Even later. I checked the whole day. You're welcome.

rn-en-6df01f14711d.text: The snow keeps coming all day. || And you'll still call it 'unexpected'.

rn-en-702d0057b04d.text: {G} can come off {WHEN}. {WHEN2} you'll want {GP} back, plus an extra layer. || Plus. I don't say 'plus' lightly.

rn-en-7514cfd27f61.text: {WHEN} {G} can come off. {WHEN2} you'll need {GP} again, and something warm on top. || 'Something warm'. I trust you. A bit.

rn-en-75a234f78093.text: Later the rain takes a break, but it returns {WHENP}. Hang on to the umbrella. || Fold it and it rains. That's the rule.

rn-en-772e0aab2345.text: It's raining all day. Bring the umbrella. || Your hair has already lost. Make peace with it.

rn-en-7896c7bb072c.text: After a break later on, the snow returns {WHENP}. || Like you to the fridge.

rn-en-7adaa5239683.text: The snow pauses later and starts again {WHENP}. || It's taking a breather. I don't need those.

rn-en-7dd034f9fd03.text: You can take {G} off {WHEN}. You won't need {GP} again after that. || After that, you're just carrying {GP} around for company.
rn-en-7dd034f9fd03.edit: You can take {G} off {WHEN}. || After that, you're just carrying {GP} around for company.

rn-en-839c9edcdb50.text: Snow for now, then a break, then more snow {WHENP}. || Part two is always the slushier one.

rn-en-84f0ab582eb3.text: A shower comes through {WHENP}, so take the umbrella. || It's only passing through. Don't take it personally.

rn-en-8685f4eefedd.text: It won't stop snowing today. || That's my forecast. I don't do 'it'll ease off' to be nice.

rn-en-874688f3d939.text: The winter coat can come off {WHEN}. || Then you're just a person carrying a duvet.

rn-en-924a7175cb5c.text: Take the umbrella along for the rain shower {WHENP}. || As opposed to the other kind of shower. I'm thorough.

rn-en-9269dee28fed.text: It could rain {WHENP}. Take the umbrella to be safe. || 'To be safe' isn't a phrase you use much, I've noticed.

rn-en-9546b71b2d60.text: The rain starts {WHENP} and doesn't stop. Bring the umbrella. || I'd say 'it'll pass', but I'm honest.

rn-en-9748d3a543a8.text: Take the umbrella for now. The rain stops later. || For now. Later it's just a stick you carry around.

rn-en-97e94352866e.text: It starts raining {WHENP} and keeps going, so bring the umbrella. || Keeps going, like your excuses for not taking it.

rn-en-98004770dd09.text: The snow stops {WHENSTOP}. || I'd say 'enjoy it while it lasts', but I've given you the exact time.

rn-en-9f336f3616b6.text: It snows all day. || You stopped finding it pretty about two snowfalls ago.

rn-en-a2839c1bd4fa.text: You can take off the hat, scarf and gloves {WHEN}. || And finally, people get to see your face again. Brace them.

rn-en-aab7413e6642.text: The rain eases off later, but bring the umbrella for now. || You'll get it out just as it stops. That's the deal.

rn-en-ad96aac6af20.text: Take the umbrella. The rain keeps going all day. || I'd sing about it, but I don't do sound. Lucky you.

rn-en-b559998c88eb.text: {WHEN} it gets a little less hot. Still warm, though. || Less hot. Not cool. Calm down.

rn-en-b5a9f3b0b74f.text: Snow starts {WHENP}. || The prettiest forecast I do all year. I'm a bit proud.

rn-en-bad4ab003a64.text: Later on the snow stops. || Then you'll miss it. Briefly.

rn-en-bfdc94ef95ea.text: It gets colder {WHEN}, so bring a hat, scarf and gloves. || I'd join you, but nothing fits a rectangle.

rn-en-c0a1e992c9b4.text: Expect snow {WHENP}. || You'll be surprised anyway.

rn-en-c589a385e5c8.text: The jacket can come off {WHEN}. || 'Can'. I'm not forcing anything. I'm a screen, not a parent.
rn-en-c589a385e5c8.edit: The jacket can come off {WHEN}. || I'm not forcing anything. I'm a screen, not a parent.

rn-en-c9889ac73008.text: Rain for now, then a dry spell, then more rain {WHENP}. The umbrella stays with you. || Not 'stays wherever you had lunch'.

rn-en-c9bf6640ba69.text: The cold sets in {WHEN}, so pack a hat, scarf and gloves. || The hat you think looks silly. It does. Wear it anyway.
rn-en-c9bf6640ba69.edit: The cold sets in {WHEN}, so pack a hat, scarf and gloves. || Yes, that hat looks silly. Wear it anyway.

rn-en-c9d394d12ae5.text: The hat, scarf and gloves can come off {WHEN}. || Yes, all three. You can manage three. Probably.

rn-en-cc2a453f94b6.text: It rains for now, stops for a bit, and starts again {WHENP}. Keep the umbrella. || A bit. Long enough to think you've won.

rn-en-d1acb938735a.text: Later the rain stops. For now, keep the umbrella with you. || Later you can tell everyone it cleared up. I told you first.

rn-en-d214e4f0f23b.text: It cools off a little {WHEN}, but stays warm. || 'A little' is carrying that whole sentence.
rn-en-d214e4f0f23b.edit: It cools off a little {WHEN}, but stays warm. || 'A little' is carrying that whole forecast.

rn-en-d8f65f9eac47.text: You can take {G} off {WHEN}. Bring an extra layer to wear with {GP} {WHEN2}. || Bring it, then wear it. Two separate skills.

rn-en-d9342b4c47b8.text: {WHENP} the rain sets in for good. Bring the umbrella. || For good. Not for your hair.

rn-en-d9672dcf28db.text: Rain is possible {WHENP}, so maybe take the umbrella. || I'm leaving this one with you. I have a reputation to protect.

rn-en-db8440246787.text: It warms up {WHEN}, so the hat, scarf and gloves can come off. || Your hair's been under that hat for hours. Good luck.

rn-en-dccb0dab66e4.text: It heats up {WHEN}, so take water with you. || Water. The clear stuff. You've seen it.
rn-en-dccb0dab66e4.edit: It heats up {WHEN}, so take water with you. || The clear stuff. You've seen it.

rn-en-dfe8a4b818d2.text: You might get some rain {WHENP}, so the umbrella could come in handy. || So could most of what's in your bag. Allegedly.

rn-en-e21a9a90b22a.text: It starts cool, but it's shorts weather {WHEN}. || Shorts might be worth a cold first hour. Says the screen indoors.
rn-en-e21a9a90b22a.edit: It starts cool, but it's shorts weather {WHEN}. || Shorts might be worth a cold first hour. Nut that’s easy for me to say. I don’t freeze.

rn-en-e252f65fa47d.text: It stops snowing {WHENSTOP}. || Right on time. I like a snowfall that keeps its word.

rn-en-ed233eaef970.text: The snow stops later. || The slush doesn't. That's on its own schedule.

rn-en-eeccd08c75bb.text: {WHEN} you won't need the hat, scarf and gloves any more. || Any more today. Don't give them away.

rn-en-f4dcaa77b4fa.text: The rain stops {WHENSTOP} and comes back {WHENP}. Keep the umbrella with you. || That dry bit is half-time.

rn-en-f559ba74c1a9.text: The rain stops {WHENSTOP} and comes back {WHENP}. Keep the umbrella with you. || Two parts. The umbrella's in both.

rn-en-f8358679242e.text: It's raining all day. Bring the umbrella. || Good day to be a screen. Bad day to be a sock.

rn-en-f85067709635.text: It warms up {WHEN}, so the jacket can come off. || Over one arm, then. Very catalogue model of you.

rn-en-f86e9caed26f.text: Take the umbrella for now. The rain stops {WHENSTOP}. || Waiting it out is an option. Not a good one, but you like those.

rn-en-f94abe5e06b2.text: Bring the umbrella. There's a shower {WHENP}. || One shower. I could have made it sound dramatic. I chose not to.

rn-en-fa259d5edbf0.text: There's a short shower {WHENP}. Have the umbrella with you. || Short, so it'll be over just as you get it open.
rn-en-fa259d5edbf0.edit: There's a short shower {WHENP}. Have the umbrella with you. || It'll be over just as you get it open.

rn-en-fc6c6c2705cb.text: {WHEN} it gets cold enough for a hat, scarf and gloves. || Cold enough that your nose will match your mood.

rn-en-fd48649a91f5.text: It might rain {WHENP}, so an umbrella wouldn't hurt. || It won't hurt. Carrying it all day might, a bit.
rn-en-fd48649a91f5.edit: It might rain {WHENP}, so an umbrella wouldn't hurt. || Carrying it all day might, actually.

rp-en-017efe08a55b.text: It's a bit cool for shorts now, but {WHEN} you'll be glad of them.

rp-en-01d56f4aa17a.text: {G} won't be needed {WHEN}, but you'll want {GP} on again {WHEN2}.

rp-en-020f12b0a2e7.text: Hold on to the umbrella. Hold on to the railing more.

rp-en-038529c96ca6.text: A sweater won't do {WHEN}, so bring a jacket.

rp-en-052d5922fb71.text: Dangerous heat today. Drink plenty of water, stay in the shade and keep out of the midday sun.

rp-en-05b23704af19.text: The freezing rain stops later, but the ice stays. Take the umbrella for now and watch your step.

rp-en-05d46e92f2c9.text: The rain doesn't stop today, so take the umbrella.

rp-en-05edd92bceda.text: The heat doesn't let up today. Drink water and find some shade.

rp-en-05f3b2436db0.text: You'll be comfortable in this for the rest of the evening.

rp-en-061f9beca7a4.text: Rain arrives {WHENP} and stays, so take the umbrella.

rp-en-063a9335a9dc.text: {WHEN} you can take {G} off, but you'll need {GP} again {WHEN2}.

rp-en-064cfc5e2e14.text: A coat on a shorts morning. Odd now, smug later.

rp-en-06ab9d63f7fc.text: Nothing to change today. What you have on is perfect.
rp-en-06ab9d63f7fc.edit: What you have on is perfect.

rp-en-09c1bc4631c6.text: Today you're allowed to walk like your gran. Encouraged, even.

rp-en-09eb689772c2.text: Some relief from the heat {WHEN}, but it stays warm.

rp-en-0b902a8b328c.text: Also fine for a Christmas party. The dancing's out of my hands.

rp-en-0ecf9bd522a7.text: It gets colder {WHEN}, so bring a hat, scarf and gloves.

rp-en-0f2308d9f527.text: I'll stay in for this one. Then again, I always do.

rp-en-0f245041f315.text: Bring a sweater. It cools down {WHEN}.

rp-en-1026571f4b4d.text: Your phone will claim it's dead at thirty percent. Drama queen.

rp-en-11aa2fef2b6c.text: Whatever you'd normally run for today, let it go.

rp-en-125462af8e00.text: Your knees will have opinions this morning. Ignore them.

rp-en-13abdfb4ceab.text: It might rain {WHENP}, so an umbrella wouldn't hurt.

rp-en-153b917fc097.text: It stays this cold until tonight.

rp-en-15bef461e08d.text: Once it warms up {WHEN}, the jacket can come off.

rp-en-16c0bbd10b74.text: That outfit will see you through the evening.

rp-en-174bd1dd506d.text: Rain is possible {WHENP}, so maybe take the umbrella.

rp-en-192d229e11c7.text: You'll be fine without the hat, scarf and gloves {WHEN}.

rp-en-1db3d6314562.text: It cools down {WHEN}, so bring a jacket.

rp-en-2031651ec2ec.text: {WHEN} it gets a little less hot. Still warm, though.

rp-en-210c4e4e104a.text: The rest of the evening needs nothing more than this.

rp-en-215fbcc137ae.text: It's wet and stormy all day. Bring the umbrella, and get inside whenever it thunders.

rp-en-21c7e6598219.text: It's freezing rain all day, so the pavements stay icy. Walk carefully and keep the umbrella with you.

rp-en-2334c88106cf.text: You'll say you love a good storm. From indoors, you do.

rp-en-239704860a5b.text: Bring the umbrella for the thunderstorm {WHENP}, and get inside when it starts.

rp-en-23b3e3abb843.text: Freezing rain all day, and the roads and pavements are icy. Take the umbrella and go slowly.
rp-en-23b3e3abb843.edit: Freezing rain all day, and the roads and pavements may be icy. Take the umbrella and go slowly.

rp-en-252e0ca17edf.text: Shorts weather {WHEN}, a layer again {WHEN2}. Wear shorts and keep {G} handy.

rp-en-26c4a2217c41.text: There's no dry spell today. Bring the umbrella.

rp-en-294f3331a01c.text: You'll still check the radar every five minutes. I'm hurt, frankly.

rp-en-297bb08d74b2.text: Umbrella up, and one shoulder will still get soaked. Every time.

rp-en-29ca6bdde522.text: It cools off a little {WHEN}, but stays warm.

rp-en-29cbd5717aec.text: You'll see your breath and pretend you're a dragon. Don't deny it.

rp-en-2a8ad6633172.text: The rain stops later, but you'll want the umbrella for now.

rr-en-e1349a8fe8cb.text: Whatever your plans are, I'm not invited. Fine.

rr-en-e13b5bf165eb.text: You'll still check your phone. As if it knows something I don't.

rr-en-e49f8fba6622.text: Bring the umbrella. Once it starts raining {WHENP}, it keeps going.

rr-en-e4dea069fd49.text: You can take the winter coat off {WHEN}.

rr-en-e5e5d62f5e61.text: Today I'm showing mostly coat. Proud of that coat.

rr-en-ebb54a4afce5.text: Expect a shower {WHENP}. The umbrella's worth taking.

rr-en-ebdf5929a64e.text: Twice your usual walking speed today. Still not exercise.
rr-en-ebdf5929a64e.edit: The cold will make you go twice your usual walking speed today. Still not exercise.

rr-en-eca12a2c4ddb.text: It gets colder {WHEN}, so bring the winter coat.

rr-en-ed509b1cd0d4.text: What you're wearing works for the whole day.

rr-en-f06a25c582a1.text: Whoever's nearby gets your snow commentary. Usually me.

rr-en-f167fa71783c.text: It warms up {WHEN}, so the winter coat can come off.

rr-en-f18ed1a940be.text: Another evening, another walk past me. No thanks, as usual.

rr-en-f19856096f93.text: You got an extra hour of sleep. It doesn't show.

rr-en-f43dc3b59a5a.text: One short walk today, and we'll hear about it for days.
rr-en-f43dc3b59a5a.edit: One short walk today, and we'll hear about it for weeks.

rr-en-f461d4b2e573.text: You'll double-check on your phone. As if it knows better.

rr-en-f620e8e3e16c.text: Try not to make your good mood everyone's problem.

rr-en-f6c64f8d1c01.text: No blue light from me. I'm the screen that lets you sleep.

rr-en-f77e25fe3839.text: You can take {G} off {WHEN}. You'll want {GP} back {WHEN2}.

rr-en-f815af3e63c2.text: In snow, I'd leave a perfect rectangle. Angels are for amateurs.

rr-en-f8879782de89.text: You asked for warm weather. Careful what you wish for.

rr-en-f9c4c466c555.text: What you have on works from now until tonight.

rr-en-fa88b0de371e.text: Make up your mind, weather. Some of us refresh on a schedule.

rr-en-fa9339393523.text: Whatever the sky does, you'll say you knew. You didn't.

rr-en-fac5ec01c68a.text: {G} can come off {WHEN}, but you'll want {GP} back {WHEN2}.

rr-en-fb1f4f842f56.text: No break from the heat today. Water and shade help.

rr-en-fbdf71499306.text: Tomorrow-you is already annoyed with tonight-you.

rr-en-fc8cea218283.text: You can take the jacket off {WHEN}.

rr-en-fd6a575afd50.text: Rain all day long. The umbrella comes along.

sd-en-001e12e94afb.text: Clocks went back. You'll wake up early anyway and resent it.
sd-en-001e12e94afb.edit: Clocks changed back. You'll wake up early anyway and resent it.

sd-en-06fcb33bc958.text: Shortest day of the year. Turn a light on later. I can't glow.

sd-en-087cb63c929c.text: Star Wars Day. My only Jedi skill: knowing what you should wear.
sd-en-087cb63c929c.note: speak like yoda for may the 4th

sd-en-095e05f210de.text: Friday. My weekend plans: be right, the whole time.
sd-en-095e05f210de.edit: My weekend plans: be right, the whole time.

sd-en-0a3a04065f27.text: May the fourth be with you. I sense no disturbance in the forecast.

sd-en-0d325c6b013f.text: Groundhog Day. Same outfit as yesterday, probably. Very on theme.
sd-en-0d325c6b013f.edit: Same outfit as yesterday, probably. Very on theme.

sd-en-0da251416ba9.text: Pi Day. I could show you the digits, but I'd run out of screen.

sd-en-1326fabb9618.text: Friday. No weekends for me, but no Mondays either. Fair trade.
sd-en-1326fabb9618.edit: No weekends for me, but no Mondays either. Fair trade.

sd-en-166a7188057c.text: Oktoberfest. You'll order a pretzel and call it dinner.

sd-en-166a92419991.text: Friday. This weekend you'll finally sort out that drawer. Sure.
sd-en-166a92419991.edit: This weekend you'll finally sort out that drawer. Sure.

sd-en-18b2934e9d97.text: Oktoberfest. Somewhere there's a pretzel bigger than me. I'm fine.

sd-en-190356911b11.text: World Bicycle Day. You'll mean to ride it. You'll mean it all day.

sd-en-1a17e10c0cb1.text: The Tour riders get a rest day. I don't. Not that I'm complaining.

sd-en-1ec41c918797.text: The Easter bunny and I both work today. Only one of us hops.

sd-en-1ef0bf2e6cd3.text: Friday afternoon. The slowest hours of the week, and I see every one.

sd-en-237efe51a88c.text: These are the clothes you're looking for. Happy Star Wars Day.
sd-en-237efe51a88c.edit: These are the clothes you're looking for.

sd-en-2732a33922fc.text: Star Wars Day. I have a bad feeling about this. Kidding. It's fine.
sd-en-2732a33922fc.edit: I have a bad feeling about this. Kidding. It's fine.

sd-en-27647f137f3c.text: Clocks forward. You'll be late for something and call it jet lag.

sd-en-2f1d93a871ba.text: Happy Easter. Unlike the eggs, the forecast isn't hidden.

sd-en-2f1fa0a83d64.text: Oktoberfest. The forecast stays steady. Everyone else, less so.

sd-en-30b27c3981aa.text: World Bicycle Day. That exercise bike makes a lovely clothes rack.
sd-en-30b27c3981aa.edit: That exercise bike makes a lovely clothes rack.

sd-en-311071098596.text: Happy Pi Day. I've done the maths for today. You can have the pie.

sd-en-3523669daeff.text: You'll say 'May the fourth be with you' to someone who hates it.
sd-en-3523669daeff.edit: Go and say 'May the fourth be with you' to someone who hates it.

sd-en-368e6af63bff.text: It's Tour de France time. Lycra is optional for the rest of us.

sd-en-3701a6ca4dea.text: Monday morning, and you're reading this before coffee. Bold.

sd-en-375b86d79cc6.text: You and the houseplants both need watering today. I don't.

sd-en-37800c12a253.text: World Bicycle Day. The forecast's the same at any speed.

sd-en-3828d6401938.text: Shortest day of the year. You'll say 'it's dark already' four times.
sd-en-3828d6401938.edit: You'll say 'it's dark already' four times.

sd-en-3985061a3802.text: Friday afternoon. Whatever happens tonight, I wasn't there.

sd-en-3febaafe580d.text: Pi Day. You know three digits and you'll say all of them today.

sd-en-407e32fe96d4.text: Pi Day, because it's 3/14. You'll pretend you knew that.

sd-en-40a9ea608d79.text: Monday. You'll ask someone about their weekend and not listen.
sd-en-40a9ea608d79.edit: You'll ask someone about their weekend and not listen.

sd-en-41d28d127aef.text: World Bicycle Day. Your bike's tyres are flat, I'm guessing.

sd-en-4470356477dc.text: Groundhog Day. Nobody has ever asked the groundhog about umbrellas.

sd-en-4659ac775c65.text: Monday. I look exactly as good as I did on Friday.

sd-en-46919b46addb.text: Monday. I've never had the Sunday-night dread. Sounds awful.
sd-en-46919b46addb.edit: I've never had the Sunday-night dread. Sounds awful.

sd-en-49a81c1c4736.text: World Bicycle Day. The outfit works on a bike too.

sd-en-4a82dbb83737.text: Monday morning. At least one of us is fully charged.

sd-en-4af808b683fc.text: Tour de France riders eat about six dinners a day. Don't get ideas.

sd-en-4f2903fc3655.text: One hour less this weekend. Don't look at me, I didn't take it.

sd-en-5368ad8a2f4b.text: Clocks back. An extra hour of sleep, and you spent it on your phone.
sd-en-5368ad8a2f4b.edit: An extra hour of sleep, and you spent it on your phone.

sd-en-5da71b687e3f.text: Oktoberfest. You'll toast so hard you spill half of it. Every time.

sd-en-5e255a8cf628.text: Monday. I don't do weekends, so I don't see what the fuss is about.

sd-en-5f3c0f7bc640.text: Try not to get stuck halfway, arms up. I can't come and help.

sd-en-606dc126be8a.text: Friday. You'll leave the laundry until Sunday night. Again.
sd-en-606dc126be8a.edit: You'll leave the laundry until Sunday night. Again.

sd-en-64ab163dce4e.text: Easter Sunday. You'll bite the ears off first. Everyone does.

sd-en-67e2a9f3408f.text: Plenty of time to start something you won't finish.

sd-en-69b34c762c31.text: Pi Day. You'll eat pie and call it maths.

sd-en-6aabdb76cac8.text: Clocks back. An hour you didn't earn. Don't spend it all at once.

sd-en-6b254854e3c7.text: Friday afternoon. You'll call Saturday 'a reset'. It'll be a nap.

sd-en-6f31fea39bba.text: Star Wars Day. You'd turn to the dark side for a biscuit.

sd-en-6fbb2e6d8a7c.text: Over and over? Amateur. I've done it for years. Happy Groundhog Day.

sd-en-7140e9783710.text: Good. One less thing to lie awake thinking about.

sd-en-73b265c30ca5.text: World Bicycle Day. No pedals, no wheels and no complaints. That's me.

sd-en-7586da17576b.text: Groundhog Day. Today a rodent does my job, and gets a crowd.
sd-en-7586da17576b.edit: Today a rodent does my job, and gets a crowd. Pathetic.

sd-en-76ed4ec4c72c.text: You'll find the Easter chocolate faster than any child.

sd-en-776edd3e5727.text: Monday. The weekend went by in about four minutes, didn't it.

sd-en-7b0f107ebde2.text: Pi Day. I'm a rectangle, so I'll be sitting this one out.
sd-en-7b0f107ebde2.edit: I'm a rectangle, so I'll be sitting this one out.

sd-en-7cbe6e6e5e84.text: An extra hour this weekend. I'd ask what you did with it, but I know.

sd-en-7d0e0546f2ea.text: You'll judge the rain by other people's umbrellas.

sd-en-7e0a4ffec82f.text: The clocks went forward. I'd say 'feel refreshed', but I don't lie.

sd-en-7f8e0408d430.text: Longest day of the year. I look my best in daylight. There's loads.
sd-en-7f8e0408d430.note: you made the mistake of starting everythign with "event name. random sentence" again. weave the context/event more into the sarcasm line. this applies to all of them.
sd-en-7f8e0408d430.edit: I look my best in daylight. There's loads of that today.

sd-en-7fe3316287c6.text: You'll try to open it with one hand, like in films. It won't.

sd-en-822ab7759d3a.text: Oktoberfest. You'll say 'just the one'. It comes in litres.

sd-en-86c55510c13d.text: Friday afternoon. Everyone slows down. I'm e-ink, I was already slow.

sd-en-87d1b8785025.text: Longest day of the year. You'll still say you ran out of time.
sd-en-87d1b8785025.edit: Longest day of the year and you'll still say you ran out of time.

sd-en-8affc0a081cd.text: The clocks went back. An extra hour, and I spent it refreshing.

sd-en-8be8169d86f5.text: Three weeks of the Tour: other people exercising. Your favourite.

sd-en-8cb4509139f5.text: You watch the Tour for the castles and the scenery. Admit it.

sd-en-8d899c6e1a91.text: Shortest day of the year. You'll still waste most of it.
sd-en-8d899c6e1a91.edit: Shortest day of the year and you'll still waste most of it.

sd-en-93597c48728a.text: Longest day of the year. From tomorrow, it's all downhill. Enjoy.
sd-en-93597c48728a.edit: From tomorrow, it's all downhill. Enjoy the darkness creep.

sd-en-939dc3f30015.text: Clocks forward, an hour gone. I didn't notice. I don't sleep.

sd-en-93b9fd0aac27.text: Tour de France. Every rider has a team car. You have me.

sd-en-965ee16865b2.text: Happy Groundhog Day. I'll be here long after the groundhog's in bed.
sd-en-965ee16865b2.edit: I'll be here long after the groundhog's in bed.

sd-en-98b9adc23aee.text: The Tour riders go over mountains. You'll take the lift up one floor.

sd-en-98fa3f0b113b.text: Clocks forward. Lighter evenings soon. You paid for them in sleep.

sd-en-99fc0296ece2.text: Monday morning. I'm the only thing in the house not annoyed about it.

sd-en-9b8a3f921aa1.text: You'll make a Groundhog Day joke today. The same one as last year.

sd-en-9c3232179ce8.text: Friday. You'll say you'll get up early tomorrow. You won't.
sd-en-9c3232179ce8.edit: You'll say you'll get up early tomorrow. You won't.

sd-en-9e4f4b62e2f4.text: Oktoberfest. One full stein weighs more than I do. Think about that.

sd-en-a08c4739cc23.text: Arriving upright counts as an achievement today. I'll allow it.

sd-en-a0d18c7db6ae.text: Tour de France. You'll pretend you understand the points jersey.

sd-en-a48772c15337.text: Two hundred kilometres for the Tour riders today. One outfit for you.
sd-en-a48772c15337.note: we cant make sure that this is actually true.

sd-en-a4fcb2ca2aba.text: Longest day of the year. You'll spend the light indoors. With me.
sd-en-a4fcb2ca2aba.edit: Longest day of the year and you'll spend it indoors. With me.

sd-en-a6a353155885.text: Friday. Weekend plans? The outfit's ready. That's my part done.
sd-en-a6a353155885.edit: Weekend plans? The outfit's ready. That's my part done.

sd-en-a82f9a2f82ea.text: It's Oktoberfest. I don't do the chicken dance. I don't do any dance.

sd-en-a9e6afbf8c87.text: Monday morning. You hit snooze, didn't you. More than once.
sd-en-a9e6afbf8c87.edit: You hit snooze, didn't you. More than once.

sd-en-af4f2d19c764.text: Shortest day of the year. Blink and you'll miss it. I don't blink.

sd-en-b0baabb25850.text: The Tour riders change jerseys more often than you'll change today.

sd-en-b8908bd38bcc.text: Clocks forward. You're running an hour behind. So, normal, plus one.

sd-en-ba1ac55e2adb.text: Monday morning. Same face as last Monday. Very consistent.
sd-en-ba1ac55e2adb.edit: Same face as last Monday. Very consistent.

sd-en-bc1dd293c163.text: Happy Easter. Your diet starts again Monday. Like last Monday.

sd-en-bd4b640d5938.text: Pi Day. Today's forecast: exactly one outfit. No decimals.
sd-en-bd4b640d5938.edit: Today's forecast: exactly one outfit. No decimals.

sd-en-c2592b8344ca.text: Oktoberfest. You'll wear the hat once and keep it for ten years.

sd-en-c479afa4d07c.text: Friday afternoon. You've been 'nearly done' since lunch.

sd-en-c67461a495fa.text: Pi Day. It never ends, a bit like your unread messages.

sd-en-c7b474747ddd.text: World Bicycle Day. You'll say you'll cycle more. From next week.

sd-en-ce8a3cf1c0fe.text: Monday. You said you'd have an early night yesterday.
sd-en-ce8a3cf1c0fe.edit: You said you'd have an early night yesterday.

sd-en-d0801cc69edc.text: Longest day of the year, and your outfit lasts all of it. Value.

sd-en-d4a863bb05f5.text: Friday afternoon. The weekend plans are 'we'll see', aren't they.
sd-en-d4a863bb05f5.edit: The weekend plans are 'we'll see', aren't they.

sd-en-d5c07f442ba8.text: Oktoberfest. Your German improves with every glass. It doesn't.

sd-en-d6e8fd560af7.text: Shortest day of the year. You'll spend the light on other screens. Noted.

sd-en-d7201624326d.text: Groundhog Day. You'd be good at it: pop out, look around, go back in.
sd-en-d7201624326d.edit: You'd be good Groundhog : pop out, look around, go back in.

sd-en-d7ecaabece85.text: Oktoberfest. Your outfit works today. So would a dirndl, apparently.

sd-en-db008e32ab1a.text: World Bicycle Day. I've never cycled. Never had a flat tyre, either.

sd-en-dba0386713cf.text: You'll eat a chocolate egg before breakfast and call it tradition.

sd-en-dc6c3dc54f82.text: Star Wars Day. You'll do the voice. Please don't do the voice.
sd-en-dc6c3dc54f82.edit: You'll do the voice. Please don't do the voice.

sd-en-dde5520d77fc.text: Oktoberfest. You'll sing along in a language you don't speak.

sd-en-e1b679198142.text: Shortest day of the year. It improves from tomorrow. You're welcome.

sd-en-e286d2fc4170.text: Clocks back. Your oven clock will be wrong until spring. You know it.
sd-en-e286d2fc4170.edit: Your oven clock will be wrong until spring. You know it.

sd-en-e4ce60f0d92f.text: Monday. You've already counted the days to the weekend.
sd-en-e4ce60f0d92f.edit: You've already started to counted the days to the weekend.

sd-en-e7e1b096197b.text: Happy Easter. One egg will turn up in July. There's always one.

sd-en-e80d318bdc3c.text: Groundhog Day, and a groundhog is having a bigger day than you.
sd-en-e80d318bdc3c.edit: A groundhog is having a better day than you.

sd-en-e9306aea8e1a.text: Longest day of the year. You'll say 'it's still so light' at ten.
sd-en-e9306aea8e1a.edit: You'll say 'it's still so light' at ten.

sd-en-edb3180bb36a.text: Happy Easter. I'm the only screen in here with no chocolate on it.

sd-en-f209e501f8dc.text: Clocks forward. You'll check three clocks and trust none of them.

sd-en-f5d3676596b7.text: Oktoberfest. Someone has to stay sober and do the forecast.
sd-en-f5d3676596b7.edit: Someone has to stay sober and do the forecast.

sd-en-f6d12efa3cf3.text: That leaves the evening free for losing the remote.

sd-en-f73dc8201cb3.text: Tour de France. You'll watch three hours of it and call it cardio.

sd-en-f8fe0e8493d2.text: Clocks went back. If you're early for everything today, that's why.

sd-en-fc50181b0cff.text: Clocks back. You'll talk about that extra hour like it was a holiday.
sd-en-fc50181b0cff.edit: You'll talk about that extra hour like it was a holiday.

sd-en-fda18d50589b.text: You'll nap through the Tour's sprint finish. You do every year.

sd-en-fdbf66cbc530.text: May the fourth. You still can't name the films in order, can you.
sd-en-fdbf66cbc530.edit: You still can't name the films in order, can you.

sd-en-fdee8033024e.text: Clocks forward. You'll blame the lost hour all week. It was one hour.
sd-en-fdee8033024e.edit: You'll blame the lost hour all week. It was one hour.

sd-en-fe3821a59dff.text: And afterwards you'll open it to dry and trip over it.

se-en-00cf6e0307d2.text: Straight onto the back of a chair. You'll find {GP} next week.

se-en-01dfc1b7a256.text: You'll end up loitering in the freezer aisle. Again.
se-en-01dfc1b7a256.edit: You'll probably end up loitering in the freezer aisle. Again.

se-en-04aa5e6d58f9.text: By midday you'll doubt me. By tonight you'll apologise.

se-en-0841db5507d9.text: You'll enjoy it right up to the first sneeze.
se-en-0841db5507d9.note: too hard t time that right. after the first sneeze the line does not work any more and we have no way of telling that that already happenend. i'd cut all of these types of sentences.

se-en-0dd0b5799d65.text: So if today goes badly, you can't blame the weather.

se-en-14273f86c00b.text: Or borrow someone's later and keep it for a year.

se-en-1682a09d9088.text: So you can stop staring into the wardrobe now.

se-en-1778e9d813f8.text: You'll call it a blizzard. It'll be a dusting.

se-en-1857096190e8.text: Cue the bread-and-milk panic. Nobody's ever explained the milk.

se-en-1a4001805928.text: Set it and forget it, like your gym membership.

se-en-1ce6a624ab1b.text: I'd say it in a warmer colour, but I only have grey.

se-en-2502e95988d4.text: A bit of snow and everything closes. I'm now the most reliable service in town.

se-en-2924d80bc24f.text: Someone will say spring's just around the corner. It's a long corner.

se-en-305cd899a1b6.text: You'll drink half the water, then lug the warm half around all day.

se-en-31a042b7a7de.text: That's your outfit sorted. The rest of your life, less so.

se-en-31a7730125bb.text: You'll text someone later to bring {GP}. Again.

se-en-33e4ced9401e.text: Somewhere a barbecue is going ahead under an umbrella. Out of spite.
se-en-33e4ced9401e.note: i like the idea, but this is not hitting right.

se-en-37d060d80efa.text: I stay cool to the touch. A seatbelt buckle can't say that.

se-en-3c918d68330c.text: Everyone will be nine for an hour, then ninety on the ice.

se-en-3cfe6f91e3a1.text: By water I mean water. Not beer, however cold.
se-en-3cfe6f91e3a1.edit: And by water I mean water. Not beer, even if it's nice and cold.

se-en-3e6e9f80ab78.text: Somewhere a neighbour just picked up a drill. For the rest of the evening.

se-en-41ea672d4538.text: Perfect for browsing flights somewhere warm and booking nothing. Again.

se-en-45f79b76aaf8.text: Then be smug at everyone sheltering in doorways. You learned that from me.

se-en-4b4c0567a2d7.text: Finally, a reason to cancel the plans you were dreading.

se-en-4e0406db781a.text: Sounds silly right now. That's exactly how it gets you.

se-en-500a6e713332.text: Everyone still remembers the last time you didn't.

se-en-54a1b5d45f07.text: You'll find shade, then complain it's the wrong shade.

se-en-5dec85e894b9.text: Or keep {GP} on out of loyalty and quietly cook.

se-en-5e4de7a4ce76.text: Best decision you'll make all day, and I made it.

se-en-5e81c91ce909.text: The first afternoon without {GP} in months. Try not to make a speech.

se-en-603b859583a0.text: Off and on again. It fixes most things, me included.
se-en-603b859583a0.edit: Off and on again. That fixes most things, me included.

se-en-6070e1ba70f1.text: And there's plenty of it. It's been dark since about four.

se-en-69e3a1a90d69.text: You'll put {GP} back on later with the face of someone who was warned.

se-en-6e6944772399.text: The yearly heating war has begun. I'm Switzerland, but flatter.

se-en-6eba7b8f4231.text: Perfect day. I had someone more deserving in mind.

se-en-721f282c5f1a.text: Great leaf-raking weather. The leaves aren't worried.

se-en-7ad2f3b404c4.text: Somewhere, a school is already drafting the snow-day email.

se-en-7cdd61294040.text: Wet leaves on every pavement. Someone's about to do an involuntary dance.

se-en-80e7533ffd72.text: My most-read sentence all week. Also my most ignored.

se-en-836ecfd47b35.text: Someone's scraping ice off a car with a credit card. Best use it's had all month.

se-en-8551b8f01d97.text: Somewhere, someone in shorts didn't read this.

se-en-8557adf7100b.text: Somewhere, the year's first barbecue is being lit. Badly.

se-en-898c7b8c0be0.text: So 'I'll go out once it warms up' means you're staying in.

se-en-8ebad52253c2.text: Somewhere a snowman has more personality than you. It's mostly carrot.

se-en-8efaecbddeef.text: That umbrella will do more for your hair than any conditioner.

se-en-8f9d5b70139c.text: First outing for {G} since spring. Brace yourself for the pockets.

se-en-92cfdb29c3d3.text: By the time you've got all that on, I'll need recharging.

se-en-94930a50790f.note: not flowing well with the forecast.

se-en-971ad7b356e7.text: Somewhere a neighbour's washing machine is just starting its spin.

se-en-9be660358821.text: Now you just need somewhere to go in it.

se-en-9d62cf95e7b1.text: In spring, that practically makes me a miracle worker.

se-en-a18cf81d097c.text: Two outfit changes in one day. Very pop star of you.

se-en-a594cb61f20c.text: Off, then back on by tonight. You do love an on-again, off-again thing.

se-en-a772e7406246.text: Today the bus smells of everyone on board. Lucky I don't have a nose.

se-en-a8d646835c25.text: You'll see the fridge light a few more times before bed, I'm guessing.

vf-en-11e1b81980e7.text: Today's as predictable as your lunch order.

vf-en-1545198e44ab.text: My snow angel would be a perfect rectangle. Classy.

vf-en-18f04d4f36bb.text: Snow stays at the door. Don't bring it near me.

vf-en-18f8bd041ad1.text: Gloves off to use your phone, every time. Brilliant system.

vf-en-199e28d5f2b5.text: Today you're your own coat rack. Congratulations.

vf-en-366e6ff11ab9.text: Making today look interesting takes skill. Lucky you've got me.

vf-en-368963ae1960.text: Your usual jacket, your usual route. Living on the edge.

vf-en-47b0156eaca2.text: I'm very good for umbrella sales.

vf-en-7bc2138a9019.text: I'd make a terrible umbrella. Gorgeous, but terrible.

vf-en-7cac794de805.text: Nothing gets me looked at like a chance of rain.

vf-en-7cc391375317.text: Unremarkable out there. You'll fit right in.

vf-en-7d81659041fe.text: Anything flat becomes a fan today. Not me, please.

vf-en-7fe7b72d86e4.text: Fifty-fifty that layer goes missing by tonight.

vf-en-81c0976ff67e.text: I'm staying on the wall where it's warm.

vf-en-82598aafe2fd.text: Snow in the drawings, and your boots are still in the closet.

vf-en-8787e3e3e3e7.text: Today's as surprising as your usual coffee order.

vf-en-882993edbbb7.text: I drew the umbrella. Bringing it is your department.

vf-en-888c10ff99bd.text: Snow is rain with better presentation. I respect that.

vf-en-8aee44822780.text: One layer fewer by the end. I drew every gripping detail.

vf-en-8bce7c2bc30b.text: Grey was my look long before winter tried it.

vf-en-8bf01b7d75c4.text: Rain makes it all glossy out there. I prefer matte.

vf-en-8bf1ee4dc3ef.text: Staying dry is easy when you live on a wall.

vf-en-8d49c921fce3.text: Taking that layer off might be the highlight of your day.

vf-en-8df43bf6b6ae.text: One of these has an umbrella. Guess which one you'll ignore.

vf-en-8e43fd74c2f8.text: Shake the snow off before you come near me.

vf-en-9009f6efd98f.text: You'll overheat a little before you admit I was right.

vf-en-91837551bfbd.text: Same outfit at both ends of the day. Lazy? No. Accurate.

vf-en-925daaf7681b.text: You'll call it 'fresh' to sound like an outdoors person.

vf-en-954b3351931b.text: You'll match the first drawing all day. Out of stubbornness.

vf-en-9669e9d08880.text: If you come back soaked, don't drip near me.

vf-en-9e97b0299eb2.text: Three outfits by tonight. You can barely manage one.

vf-en-9fc6a86a9298.text: I was grey before winter made it cool.

vf-en-a211888f0e02.text: The umbrella makes a guest appearance today. I cast it myself.

vf-en-a5f24dc1e3d6.text: Today you're a coat rack with legs. Well done.

vf-en-a6729d542f1e.text: You won't get a sad little cloud icon from me. I've got artistic integrity.

vf-en-a78b741d65fe.text: Get ready to have feelings about air conditioning.

vf-en-a8c194980003.text: You'll search 'ice cream near me' later. Twice.

vf-en-aa05f7fde6a6.text: My only weakness is the cold. Kidding, I don't have one.

vf-en-b349107de04c.text: Flat, pale and cool. I'm built for days like this.

vf-en-b35e454a1f45.text: Other screens get to show paintings. I get today's weather.

vf-en-b7ccd38be1f2.text: Remember wishing for summer? This is what you get.

vf-en-b816a3d07b69.text: Less and less clothing in these drawings. I'm keeping it tasteful.

vf-en-b9e3ab39c745.text: Different layers in every drawing. Same cold in all of them.

vf-en-ba7853478ae9.text: One of us is about to sweat. Not me.

vf-en-bf19055e32bf.text: That layer coming off could be the peak of your day.

vf-en-c56965a9c2bc.text: Someone turned the outside up too far. Don't look at me.

vf-en-c686bf889afd.text: You'll call it 'crisp' like you go hiking or something.

vf-en-c79a88d403ff.text: Snow in the drawings. You'll act surprised anyway.
vf-en-c79a88d403ff.edit: Snow in the forecast. You'll be surprised anyway.

vf-en-c81f3109d2ff.text: I give it even odds you lose that layer by tonight.

vf-en-c835baa284e1.text: Snow is just rain that cares about presentation.

vf-en-c85ea96a9039.text: Spot the difference: one of these has an umbrella.

vf-en-c907abca0263.text: I refresh every few minutes. Wet socks don't.

vf-en-ca90af0e18cf.text: Same jacket, same route. You wild thing.

vf-en-d090081ccda2.text: You'll be a bit too warm before you admit I was right.

vf-en-d5d05750b977.text: Three outfits for one day. I'm basically a costume department.
vf-en-d5d05750b977.edit: Three outfits for one day. You're basically a costume department.

vf-en-d92a9997ab0b.text: Watch a layer vanish later. I'm basically a magician.

vf-en-da9538c74217.text: You'll walk twice as fast today. Still not cardio.

vf-en-dabadb8b344e.text: Gripping weather. I can barely stay on the wall.

vf-en-db165a5a6432.text: I'll be on the wall, dry and smug.

vf-en-dc14e2638c93.text: 'It's not that cold,' you'll say. Your ears won't agree.

vf-en-dc83d8795b8d.text: There's snow in this lineup. I made it look easy.

vf-en-e017e6e415ca.text: Today you'll fan yourself with anything flat. Please don't use me.

vf-en-e01cdf188665.text: You'll make that noise once you're outside. You know the one.

vf-en-e13b5bf165eb.text: You'll still check your phone. As if it knows something I don't.

vf-en-e789f752ea79.text: The drawings get lighter. Your mood won't.

vf-en-e86ec229c474.text: I drew the extra layer for later. Even I plan ahead.

vf-en-ee3177690686.text: You'll see the later drawing and leave without the layer anyway.
vf-en-ee3177690686.edit: You've seen the forecast and leave without the extra layer anyway.

vf-en-f461d4b2e573.text: You'll double-check on your phone. As if it knows better.

vf-en-f815af3e63c2.text: In snow, I'd leave a perfect rectangle. Angels are for amateurs.

vf-en-f8879782de89.text: You asked for warm weather. Careful what you wish for.

vf-en-f9f334e1ef56.text: Staring at me longer won't make it warmer.

vf-en-fa88b0de371e.text: Make up your mind, weather. Some of us refresh on a schedule.

vf-en-fa8b8fb4d29a.text: The cold will make you go twice your usual walking speed today. Still not exercise.
